data.abstract: 油气藏数值模拟技术是认识油气藏、设计开发方案、部署油气产量的重要技术手段,该技术通过建立符合多孔介质中油气水渗流机理的数学模型、构建求解PDE方程的数学算法,并利用计算机技术进行计算。随着油气藏开发的规模性和复杂性的提升,油气藏数值模拟处理规模和模拟复杂性日益提高,传统油气藏数值模拟面临着计算速度慢、耗时长的问题。深度学习作为数据科学的重要技术手段,与传统模拟技术的深度融合将有助于油气藏数值模拟的提速提效。本文将详细分析油气藏数值模拟的技术环节及深度学习融合的可行性和未来发展趋势。通过本文,以期引起更多的从事深度学习的专家融入油气领域的研究。 学术
data.speakerBio: 吴淑红,博士,教授级高级工程师,博导。中国石油勘探开发研究院人工智能研究中心书记,中国石油天然气集团有限公司勘探开发人工智能技术研发中心副主任、技术委员会秘书长。北京计算数学学会常务理事,CSIAM大数据与人工智能专业委员会委员,SPE亚太会议技术委员会委员和分会主席。长期扎根于科研生产一线,致力于油田开发、油藏数值模拟及智能化油气开发专业软件方面的理论技术研究,先后承担并主持多项国家、中国石油、北京市重大科研和国际合作研发项目,主持研发新一代油藏数值模拟技术和软件HiSim®。荣获省部级科技进步奖特等奖1项、一等奖4项、二等奖4项,中国石油十大科技进展2项;获SPE国际石油工程协会区域服务奖;国家授权发明专利6件、软件著作权30余项、商标注册权1项,发表论文90余篇,著作3部。

data.title: 华师经管学术讲座第452期（管理）
data.topic: Virtuous Leader, Virtuous Firm: How Humble CEOs Build Good Firms by Fostering Organizational Virtuousness
data.speaker: 尤树洋
data.speakerAffiliation: 东北财经大学工商管理学院
data.speakerBio: 尤树洋,东北财经大学工商管理学院副教授,组织与管理理论研究中心主任。研究领域涉及战略领导力和组织行为。主持完成国家自然科学基金 1项,获优秀结项 。 近年来在 Journal of Product Innovation Management (ABS4), Journal of Business Research (ABS3) , Management and Organization Review (ABS3) , 《管理世界》等期刊发表论文 20余篇,出版译著1部。荣获 Emerald Citation of Excellence Award ( 2015)、第七届高校科研优秀成果奖(人文社科)论文二等奖( 2015)、"江苏省第十六届哲学社会科学优秀成果奖"二等奖(2020)、 辽宁省研究生教育教学成果奖一等奖 。担任 Management and Organization Review 、 《经济管理》等期刊匿名评审工作,荣获《管理学季刊》( 2019、2 022 )最佳评审人。
data.abstract: The rise of positive organizational scholarship has brought virtues back to business studies, applying a positive lens to organizations. While some scholars highlight the importance of individual virtues in promoting human flourishing, others have emphasized a set of "organizational virtues" that create both individual and collective benefits. These studies, however, are quiet on how and when individual virtues may help to build good firms. We address the how by examining the role of CEO humility in fostering organizational virtuousness — a constellation of virtues that manifest in collective behaviors, activities, processes, and policies in organizations — which in turn leads to positive firm outcomes, including improved financial performance and external stakeholder support. To explicate when, we specify firm status as a moderator of the positive effect of CEO humility on firm outcomes via organizational virtuousness. Using a sample of 253 firms from China, we find support for our main hypotheses. We discuss important implications for research on humility and organizational virtuousness.

data.title: 学术报告-王钰聪
data.topic: Stability of rotating gaseous stars
data.location: 数科院西楼二楼会议室
data.speaker: 王钰聪
data.listTitle: 学术报告-王钰聪
data.abstract: We consider stability of rotating gaseous stars modeled by the Euler-Poisson system with general equation of states. When the angular velocity of the star is Rayleigh stable, we proved a sharp stability criterion for axi-symmetric perturbations. We also obtained estimates for the number of unstable modes and exponential trichotomy for the linearized Euler-Poisson system. By using this stability criterion, we proved that for a family of slowly rotating stars parameterized by the center density with fixed angular velocity, the turning point principle is not true. That is, unlike the case of non-rotating stars, the change of stability of the rotating stars does not occur at extrema points of the total mass. By contrast, we proved that the turning point principle is true for the family of slowly rotating stars with fixed angular momentum distribution. When the angular velocity is Rayleigh unstable, we proved linear instability of rotating stars. Moreover, we gave a complete description of the spectra and sharp growth estimates for the linearized Euler-Poisson system. This is a joint work with Zhiwu Lin. 学术
data.speakerBio: 王钰聪,2021年6月获得厦门大学理学博士学位。毕业后于北京大学做博士后,主要从事描述气态星体模型的偏微分方程的稳定性方面研究。部分论文发表在国际重要学术期刊Commun. Math.Phys.

data.title: 华师经管学术讲座第451期（管理）（讲座地点已更改）
data.topic: The joint influence of individual and collective psychological ownership and its social consequences in work teams
data.speaker: 张瑞雪
data.speakerAffiliation: 宁波诺丁汉大学商学院
data.speakerBio: 张瑞雪,宁波诺丁汉大学商学院助理教授,研究兴趣包括前瞻性人格、创造力、心理所有权、顾客服务和辱虐式管理等。相关研究成果发表在Journal of Applied Psychology, Personnel Psychology、Journal of Service Research等本专业国际知名期刊。
data.abstract: Current research on psychological ownership mostly focuses on its effects on employee work-related outcomes, whereas its impact on social outcomes has yet to be examined. Drawing on the promotion-prevention framework, we investigate its impact on two social outcomes—received help and experienced ostracism—through dual mechanisms, i.e., proactive behaviors and territorial behaviors. We also tested collective psychological ownership as a moderator in the foregoing relationships. We tested our hypotheses progressively through two time-lagged survey studies from different fields, beauty salons teams (Study 1) and nursing teams (Study 2). Study 1 results supported the main and mediating relationships. The results largely support our theorizing. Our research offers several theoretical and practical implications for cross-level psychological ownership and its dual side social influences.

data.title: 李英英——Quantum simulation for High Energy Physics
data.topic: Quantum simulation for High Energy Physics
data.speaker: 李英英
data.listTitle: 李英英——Quantum simulation for High Energy Physics
data.abstract: High-energy physics is facing challenges, such as understanding the origin of observed baryon asymmetry and the nature of dark matter. Scenarios to address these challenges often involve dynamics that, at present, cannot be solved due to computational or theoretical limitations. An elegant solution exists in the form of real-time simulation with quantum computers, though hampered by limited quantum resources for the foreseeable future. In my talk, I will motivate the critical need for real-time simulation in high-energy physics, discuss existing challenges/theoretical developments involved when formulating quantum field theory on a quantum computer, and extracting physical quantities from it in the continuum limit.
data.speakerBio: 李英英, 2019年于香港科技大学获得博士学位,随后赴费米实验室做博士后,于2023年加入中国科学技术大学交叉中心和彭桓武中心任副研究员。研究领域是粒子物理理论与唯象学,方向主要为新物理的探索,包括利用对撞机等实验探索新物理,发展量子计算技术以改进相关理论的预测等。

data.topic: One-Share-One-Vote and Dual-Class Shares in the Laboratory
data.speaker: 包特
data.speakerAffiliation: 新加坡南洋理工大学经济系
data.speakerBio: 包特,新加坡南洋理工大学经济系长聘副教授。主要研究领域为实验经济学,行为金融,中国经济和合约理论。其研究成果发表于Economic Journal, European Economic Review, Experimental Economics, Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization, Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control等国际期刊和《经济研究》《世界经济》《管理世界》《管理科学学报》等国内期刊。担任Singapore Economic Review副编辑,和多家期刊和科研基金的匿名审稿人。
data.abstract: We test the seminal Grossman and Hart (1988) model on the optimality of the one-share-one-vote (OSOV) share structure against the dual-class share (DCS) structure in a laboratory experiment. We show qualitative support to their theoretical prediction asserting that the more efficient contender of control (incumbent or raider) is more likely to win the takeover contest under OSOV than DCS. We also find that the price deviation from the fundamental value is smaller under OSOV than DCS. Overall, our results show supportive evidence for better allocation and information efficiency of OSOV relative to DCS.

data.topic: First-order methods for convex optimization and monotone inclusions under local Lipschitz conditions
data.speaker: 吕召松
data.listTitle: 学术报告-吕召松
data.abstract: In this talk, I will discuss first-order methods for two problem classes: convex optimization with locally Lipschitz continuous gradient and monotone inclusions with locally Lipschitz continuous point-valued operators. For convex optimization, we will propose a first-order method to find an epsilon-KKT solution, while for monotone inclusions, a primal-dual extrapolation method will be presented to find an epsilon-residual solution. These problem classes extend beyond the well-studied ones in the literature. The proposed methods are parameter-free, with verifiable termination criteria, and exhibit nearly optimal complexity. I will also share some preliminary numerical results to demonstrate their performance. 学术

data.title: 学术报告-庞宏奎
data.topic: Sine transform based preconditioners for fractional diffusion inverse source problems
data.speaker: 庞宏奎
data.speakerAffiliation: 江苏师范大学数学与统计学院
data.listTitle: 学术报告-庞宏奎
data.abstract: We investigate an inverse problem with quasi-boundary value regularization for recovering a source term of space-time fractional diffusion equations from the final observation. A sine transform based preconditioner is established for the discrete linear systems arising from the finite difference discretization of the regularized well-posed problem. According to the multilevel $\tau$-structure and 2-by-2 block form, the proposed preconditioner can be inverted efficiently by the fast sine transform and fast Fourier transform. Theoretically, we show that except for a number of outliners, the eigenvalues of the preconditioned matrix are located within a rectangular domain which is uniformly bounded away from zero. Numerical experiments are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed preconditioner. 学术

data.title: 华师经英seminar第50期
data.topic: 宗族文化的"增信"效应:来自企业贷款违约的证据
data.speaker: 张磊
data.speakerAffiliation: 上海财经大学经济学院
data.speakerBio: 张磊,华南师范大学经济与管理学院政治经济学专业 2000 届硕士研究生毕业,目前在上海财经大学经济学院经济史专业攻读博士研究生。
data.abstract: 宗族文化作为非正式制度的重要组成部分是否会对企业信贷违约行为产生影响?以沪深A股上市公司作为研究对象,本文实证检验了宗族文化如何影响企业贷款违约行为。结果显示,宗族文化密度越大的地区,企业贷款违约的概率越低,这说明宗族文化可以抑制企业贷款违约行为。作用机制检验证实,宗族文化通过降低代理成本与创新投入两个渠道降低企业贷款违约的概率。异质性分析表明,宗族文化对企业信贷违约行为的抑制作用在高管为本地人的企业,民营企业,以及经济基础较差、市场化程度较低的地区更为显著。进一步研究发现,宗族文化有助于缓解企业融资约束,具体表现为企业获得的总贷款尤其是短期贷款显著增加。

data.title: 福州大学余雪佳博士学术报告
data.topic: 非厄米强关联狄拉克费米子
data.speaker: 余雪佳
data.listTitle: 福州大学余雪佳博士学术报告
data.abstract: 一方面,传统强关联狄拉克系统中新奇的量子物态和相变引起了人们极大的兴趣。另一方面,非厄米物理近年来逐渐成为冷原子和凝聚态物理中的一大前沿。在本次报告中,我们探索了狄拉克费米子系统中强关联与非厄米效应之间的相互竞争可能会演生出什么新奇量子物相和相变。为了系统研究这个问题,我们首次发展了针对非厄米多体系统的投影量子蒙特卡洛算法,并利用该方法得到了六角格子上非厄米哈伯德模型的基态相图。有趣的是,哈伯德相互作用诱导的反铁磁长程序随着非厄米强度的增加而增强。更值得注意的是,我们发现即使出发点为非厄米格点模型,在低能下系统从狄拉克半金属相到反铁磁有序相之间的相变点属于厄米手征XY普适类,这表明量子临界点处会演生出厄米性。最后,我们对上述数值结果提供了理论解释。本工作中采用的数值精确的量子蒙特卡洛方法很容易应用于其他非厄米相互作用费米子模型,从而为研究非厄米系统中的量子多体物理开辟了新的道路。
data.speakerBio: 余雪佳,2018年本科毕业于湘潭大学物理与光电工程学院。2023年博士毕业于北京大学量子材料科学中心。福建省组织部教育科研类引进生,福州大学物理与信息工程学院副教授。曾获北京大学优秀毕业生,湖南省优秀毕业生等荣誉十余项。Europhysics letters (EPL) Distinguished Referee。主要研究方向为量子多体系统中新奇量子物态和量子相变(平衡或动力学)的解析和数值研究。博士期间一作在国内外物理学权威期刊发表SCI 学术论文 8 篇,其中Phys. Rev. Lett, 1 篇,Phys.Rev.A/B/E,4 篇。正在审稿的一作Phys. Rev. Lett,2 篇。

data.abstract: 随着人口红利减退和劳动力成本上涨,中国制造业转型升级已迫在眉睫。作为"制造业皇冠顶端的明珠",工业机器人所引领的智能制造被寄予厚望。近年来党中央密集出台一系列支持机器人发展的政策,机器人产业迎来跨越式发展的窗口期。全球范围来看,机器人的兴起有效地缓解劳动力供给缺口,为各国经济增长提供新的机遇。不过,机器人大规模应用将产生"创造性破坏",在提升生产力的同时也使旧生产方式瓦解重组,其对劳动力市场的影响意义深远。 本报告利用团队前期在东南沿海地区开展的企业深度调查,并结合国际机器人联盟数据以及代表性大型微观调查,挖掘机器人兴起与劳动力市场新变化的特征事实,揭示机器人兴起对中国劳动力市场的重塑机制,为未雨绸缪应对潜在冲击,实现更加充分更高质量就业提供新的政策视野。

data.title: 侯德富——Magnetized thermal dense QCD matter with rotation
data.topic: Magnetized thermal dense QCD matter with rotation
data.speaker: 侯德富
data.listTitle: 侯德富——Magnetized thermal dense QCD matter with rotation
data.abstract: First, we study the rotation effects of the hot and dense QCD matter in a non-perturbative regime by the gauge/gravity duality. We use the gravitational model that is designated to match the state-of-the-art lattice data on the thermal properties of (2+1)-flavor QCD and predict the location of the critical endpoint and the first-order phase transition line at large baryon chemical potential without rotation. After introducing the angular velocity via a local Lorentz boost, we investigate the thermodynamic quantities for the system under rotation in a self-consistent way. We find that the critical temperature and baryon chemical potential associated with the QCD phase transition decrease as the angular velocity increases. Moreover, some interesting phenomena are observed near the critical endpoint. Secondly we calculate the spectral function and dissociation of the heavy vector mesons with the presence of an intense magnetic field in a hot and dense medium. The energy loss of heavy quark in a Magnetized thermal dense QCD matter is also studied. We find that the drag force of heavy quark and jet quenching parameter behave an enhancement near the phase transition temperature. The peak values of drag force and jet quenching parameter are pushed towards lower temperature with increasing B or μ. The heavy quark may lose more energy when perpendicular to magnetic field which is consistent with the results of jet quenching parameter.

data.title: 学术报告-张伏
data.topic: A Q-learning Algorithm for Discrete-time Linear-quadratic Control with Random Parameters of Unknown Distribution
data.location: 数科院西楼二楼会议室
data.speaker: 张伏
data.listTitle: 学术报告-张伏
data.abstract: This talk studies an infinite horizon optimal control problem for discrete-time linear systems and quadratic criteria, both with random parameters which are independent and identically distributed with respect to time. A classical approach is to solve an algebraic Riccati equation that involves mathematical expectations and requires certain statistical information of the parameters. In this paper, we propose an iterative algorithm in the spirit of Q-learning for the situation where only one random sample of parameters emerges at each time step. The first theorem proves the equivalence of three properties: the convergence of the learning sequence, the well-posedness of the control problem, and the solvability of the algebraic Riccati equation. The second theorem shows that the adaptive feedback control in terms of the learning sequence stabilizes the system as long as the control problem is well-posed. Numerical examples are presented to illustrate our results. This is a joint work with Kai Du and Qingxin Meng. 学术
data.speakerBio: 张伏,上海理工大学理学院副教授,特聘博士生导师。分别在中国矿业大学信息与计算科学专业获得理学学士学位、南京大学基础数学专业获理学硕士学位、复旦大学运筹与控制专业获理学博士。主要研究领域有随机分析、随机控制、金融数学与人工智能。主持国家自然科学基金面上项目1项,青年基金项目1项。多篇文章在《SIAM J. Contrl. Optimal》、《Stochastic Process. Appl.》、《Ann. Inst. Henri Poincaré Probab. Stat》、《Discrete Contin. Dyn. Syst.》等主流学术杂志发表。

data.topic: Gibbs measure for NLS with a trapping potential
data.speaker: 王玉昭
data.speakerAffiliation: 英国伯明翰大学数学学院
data.listTitle: 学术报告-王玉昭
data.abstract: In this talk, I will present some of our recent work on the Gibbs measures construction for NLS with a trapping potential. Such Gibbs measures appeared in the study of statistical Bose gases and Bose-Einstein condensates. In particular, for the defocusing case with quartic nonlinear interactions, it has been rigorously derived from many-body quantum mechanics. I will go over some recent progress about the construction of the focusing Gibbs measures and their application. 学术

data.topic: Decentralized Algorithms for Spatially Distributed Systems
data.speaker: 宋国辉
data.speakerAffiliation: Old Dominion University数学与统计系
data.listTitle: 学术报告-宋国辉
data.abstract: In a centralized system, all processing and decision-making is handled by a single entity, which can become a bottleneck as the system grows in size and complexity. Decentralized algorithms distribute the processing load across multiple nodes, allowing the system to scale much more effectively. Many decentralized algorithms distribute the global objective function across multiple nodes such that each node only handle its own local objective function. 学术

data.speakerBio: 孙昌璞,理论物理学家,中国科学院院士,发展中国家科学院院士,中国工程物理研究院研究生院院长,北京大学物理学院客座讲席教授,北京计算科学研究中心讲座教授。本科毕业于东北师大物理系,于南开大学获博士学位。曾任东北师大教授,中科院理论所研究员。获得了国家自然科学二等奖和美国ISI"经典引文奖"等奖励以及全国先进工作者等荣誉称号。他长期从事量子物理、数学物理、量子信息基础理论的研究,发表文章350余篇,不少工作有长期的影响。近年的工作主要集中在复杂系统统计热力学和可靠性理论的研究,并积极探索国家需求牵引基础研究的模式创新。目前他主持国家自然科学基金委员会的基础中心项目《基础能源物理的科学问题》。孙昌璞院士十分重视青年人才的培养,10次被评为中科院优秀导师,指导的研究生有2人获全国"百篇优秀博士学位论文"、多人获得"中国科学院优秀博士论文"和科学院院长特别奖等。他长期负责与组织我国物理学科战略规划工作,是国家自然科学基金委员会委员,中国物理学会副理事长,并担任中国科学院哲学研究所学术委员会主任。

data.speaker: 田玉斌
data.listTitle: 学术报告-田玉斌
data.abstract: In optimization problems, the expensive black-box function implies severely restricted budgets in terms of evaluation. Some Bayesian optimization methods have been proposed to solve this problem, such as expected improvement(EI) and hierarchical expected improvement(HEI). However, most of these methods are nonparallel and use a one-point-at-a-time strategy. This study proposes a new parallel frame work that uses the minimum energy criterion. 学术
data.speakerBio: 田玉斌,中国现场统计研究会试验设计分会副理事长,中国数学会均匀设计分会副主任委员,长期从事数理统计、试验设计与可靠性优化方向的研究,发表学术论文60余篇;多次在全国和国际学术会议做大会报告和邀请报告。 先后主持国家自然科学基金委项目、国家国防科技工业局技术基础项目和航天预先研究项目、原总装备部共性技术预先研究项目和重点基金项目10余项。研究成果已经应用于我国十余种燃爆产品的可靠性设计与分析、以及天宫系列卫星和我国新一代遥感卫星智能系统的设计与研发。获国防科技进步奖2项。

data.abstract: Space-filling designs are useful for exploring the relationship between the response and factors, especially when the true model is unknown. The wrap-around L2-discrepancy is an important measure of the uniformity, and has often been used as a type of space-filling criterion. However, most obtained designs are generated through stochastic optimization algorithms, and cannot achieve the lower bound of the discrepancies and are only nearly uniform. 学术

data.title: 学术报告-李文彬
data.topic: Data-driven studies for inverse problems in imaging
data.location: 数科院西楼二楼会议室
data.speaker: 李文彬
data.speakerAffiliation: 哈尔滨工业大学深圳校区
data.listTitle: 学术报告-李文彬
data.abstract: We present our recent work in data-driven studies for inverse problems in imaging. The motivation is to deal with large-scale inverse problems with measurement data contaminated by random noises. The following contents will be included. (1) A stochastic gradient descent approach with partitioned-truncated singular value decomposition for large-scale inverse problems of magnetic modulus data. This work aims to develop efficient computational methods for massive datasets in nonlinear magnetic inverse problem which were infeasible to process due to the restriction of computational resource. (2) uniformly convex neural networks and iterated network Tikhonov (iNETT) method. We propose rigorous theories and detailed algorithms for the construction of convex and uniformly convex neural networks. Then we develop an iNETT algorithm which employs data-driven regularizers for the solution of ill-posed inverse problems. 学术
data.speakerBio: 李文彬, 哈尔滨工业大学深圳校区,副教授, 在四川大学先后获得学士和硕士学位, 在香港科技大学获得哲学博士(数学)学位, 导师为梁承裕和王筱平教授, 在 Michigan State University 从事博士后研究工作, 研究领域主要包含反问题建模与计算和偏微分方程数值解.

data.title: 学术报告-艾明要
data.topic: Optimal Distributed Subsampling Techniques for Big Data Analysis
data.location: 数科院西楼二楼会议室
data.speaker: 艾明要
data.speakerAffiliation: 北京大学数学科学学院
data.listTitle: 学术报告-艾明要
data.abstract: Subsampling reduces computational burden and maintains statistical efficiency for big data. We review subsampling techniques for different models. If data volume is too large, nonuniform subsampling with replacement is infeasible. Poisson subsampling solves this problem. A distributed subsampling framework computes statistics on smaller data partitions. Strategies are evaluated through numerical experiments. 学术
data.speakerBio: 北京大学数学科学学院统计学二级教授、博士生导师。兼任全国应用统计专业学位研究生教育指导委员会委员,中国现场统计研究会副理事长,试验设计分会理事长,高维数据统计分会副理事长,统计调查分会副理事长。中国数学会理事,普及与传播工作委员会委员,均匀设计分会副主任,中国概率统计学会第十一届理事会秘书长。中国统计学会常务理事。担任四个国际重要SCI期刊Statistica Sinica、JSPI、SPL和Stat的副主编,国内核心期刊 《系统科学与数学》、《数理统计与管理》、《数学进展》编委,科学出版社《统计与数据科学丛书》编委。主要从事大数据采样理论与算法、试验设计与分析、计算机仿真试验与建模、应用统计的教学和研究工作,在AoS、JASA、Biometrika、《中国科学》等国内外重要期刊发表学术论文八十余篇。主持国家自然科学基金重点项目1项、面上项目5项,另参与完成多项科技部重点研发计划项目。曾获得北京大学优秀博士学位论文指导教师和北京市高等学校优秀教学成果奖二等奖。

data.topic: 地方政府纾困与城投债发行:来自地区新增AAA专业担保公司的证据
data.speaker: 林晚发
data.speakerAffiliation: 武汉大学经济与管理学院会计系
data.speakerBio: 林晚发,武汉大学经济与管理学院会计系副教授、博士生导师,入选湖北省"青年拔尖"人才培养计划(2022)。主要研究方向为债券市场与金融中介相关问题,研究成果发表在《经济研究》、《管理世界》、《金融研究》等国内外学术期刊上。相关成果获得财政部中国会计学会优秀论文一等奖、国家知识产权局优秀研究成果二等奖以及湖北省社会科学优秀成果二等奖(排名第一),主持国家自然科学基金青年项目以及教育部人文社会科学青年项目。
data.abstract: 本文以 AAA 专业担保机构的成立来度量刻画地方政府纾困力度的差异,分析地方政府纾困如何影响城投公司债券发行。实证结果表明: AAA 专业担保机构的成立有利于提高城投公司债券的发行金额和发行数量。机制检验发现, AAA 专业担保机构的成立显著提高了地区内有担保城投债的发行比例,另外,债券层面数据结果表明新增高评级担保资源有利于提高债券评级和促进债券合理定价,以此达到发行评级门槛,同时保护债券市场投资者和提高一级市场投资者参与度,进而助力城投债发行 。 异质性分析发现, AAA 专业担保机构对城投债发行的促进作用在担保资源紧缺、地方政府债务风险高和财政压力大的省份中更显著。 进一步分析发现,在与企业匹配方面, AAA 专业担保机构更多地为主体评级较差的未曾发债和曾选择担保的企业提供担保,体现出高质量担保效应;在地区担保资源方面,地区内非 AAA 专业担保机构被 AAA 专业担保机构挤占的业务份额被发债基本面较好的企业所填补,从而实现担保资源的层级互补。因此, A AA 专业担保机构的成立在丰富地区担保资源的同时并未对一般担保机构的业务产生挤占效应,整体上丰富了地区担保资源。本文从地区新增担保资源角度分析了地方政府纾困的新渠道,并在一定上打开了地区担保资源担保业务结构的黑箱。

data.topic: The Historical Persistence of Entrepreneurship: Ming-Qing Businessmen and the Rise of Township and Village Enterprises in China
data.speaker: 刘瑞明
data.speakerAffiliation: 中国人民大学国家发展与战略研究院
data.speakerBio: 刘瑞明,中国人民大学国家发展与战略研究院教授、博导,国有经济研究院执行院长,《产业经济评论》执行副主编,近年来以第一作者或通讯作者身份在《经济研究》、《管理世界》、《经济学季刊》、《世界经济》、《中国工业经济》、Research Policy、Journal of Corporate Finance等杂志发表60余篇论文,主持国家社会科学基金重大项目、国家自然科学基金项目、教育部人文社科基金项目等多项国家级、省部级项目,曾获得"教育部中国高校科学优秀成果奖"、"全国优秀博士论文提名奖"、"第四届张培刚发展经济学青年学者奖"、"第六届黄达-蒙代尔经济学奖"、"首届谭崇台发展经济学奖"、"第四届洪银兴经济学奖"等学术荣誉。
data.abstract: Can entrepreneurship persist, even after the imprisonment of the market? Using county-level panel data for Shaanxi, China, from 1978 to 1990, we examine the causal relationship between Ming-Qing Businessmen (MQB) and Township and Village Enterprise (TVE) establishment. Leveraging the policy shock targeting TVEs in 1984, in a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with more MQB experienced faster TVEs' growth after the policy. This growth is economically significant, persistent and can be explained by the sensitivity and ability to capture opportunities for TVEs' development in different counties, bringing considerable long-term economic welfare.

data.topic: 黑洞的超辐射效应及其应用
data.speaker: 麦展风
data.speakerAffiliation: 北京大学科维理天文与天体物理研究所
data.listTitle: 北京大学麦展风助理研究员学术报告
data.abstract: 黑洞的超辐射效应是目前黑洞物理及引力波天文学领域中一个重要课题。研究表明,通过超辐射效应,旋转/带电(Kerr/RN)黑洞中的能量可以被黑洞周围的物质所提取。在超辐射机制下,Kerr黑洞与超轻轴子形成的引力原子系统是连续引力波源的重要候选者之一。本报告首先以彭罗斯过程为引,对黑洞的超辐射效应作背景概述。接着介绍带电黑洞超辐射效应的性质,其中重点介绍STU超引力框架下极端带电黑洞中超辐射不稳定的准束缚态与准正则模性质。最后,本报告介绍由奇异致密天体(Exotic Compact Object)基于超辐射不稳定机制所形成的引力原子系统及其引力波特性。
data.speakerBio: 麦展风,北京大学科维理天文与天体物理研究所助理研究员/博士后。2015年本科毕业于华南师范大学物理学勷勤创新班;2018年硕士毕业于北京师范大学;2022年博士毕业于天津大学。主要研究兴趣是黑洞物理、中子星物理及引力波,特别是黑洞及中子星的准正则模与超辐射不稳定性在引力波中的应用。在Physical Review D, Science China Physics, Mechanics & Astronomy, European Physical Journal C, Physics Letter B, Journal of High Energy Physics 发表文章14篇,其中第一作者4篇,通讯作者2篇。目前主持国家自然科学基金委理论物理专项基金1项。

data.abstract: The idea using neural networks to solve combinatorial optimization problems has been shown to be effective and time-saving in recent years. data.topic: 非贝叶斯劝说
data.speaker: 张旭
data.speakerAffiliation: 香港科技大学(广州)创新创业与公共政策学域
data.speakerBio: 张旭助理教授2020年5月获布朗大学经济学博士,现任职于香港科技大学(广州)创新创业与公共政策学域。其研究领域包括微观经济学理论、信息经济学、行为经济学与实验经济学。研究主题涵盖信息设计、非理性概率推断、信任与合作以及社会偏好等问题。主要研究成果发表于Journal of Political Economy、Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization等知名经济学国际期刊。
data.abstract: 该成果已在Journal of Political Economy发表,探讨如何将信息设计中的贝叶斯劝说模型(Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011)推广到信息接收者可能为非贝叶斯理性人的情境,分析非理性概率推断如何影响最优劝说的设计。研究发现,当接收者的概率推断符合一大类信念更新法则时,经典的"凹化"方法仍可以用来求解最优劝说。作者们完整刻画了这类信念更新法则,并证明其包含许多文献中常见的非贝叶斯模型。同时,进一步探索了非贝叶斯劝说中的一系列问题,包括显示原理何时成立,信息发送者偏好何种信念更新法则的接收者,以及发送者何时能从劝说中获利等。上述方法对稳健劝说问题亦有所启示。

data.title: 熊伟志——Current Status of Proton Charge Radius Puzzle
data.topic: Current Status of Proton Charge Radius Puzzle
data.speaker: 熊伟志
data.listTitle: 熊伟志——Current Status of Proton Charge Radius Puzzle
data.abstract: The proton electric charge radius (rp) is an important quantity as it characterizes the spatial distribution of the proton's charge, and is also an essential physical input for the bound-state Quantum Electrodynamics calculations for the hydrogen atomic energy levels. In 2010, an unprecedentedly precise result was obtained using a novel muonic hydrogen spectroscopy technique. Nevertheless, this result triggered the "proton charge radius puzzle", as it was 7σ smaller than measurements from previous ep elastic scattering and ordinary hydrogen spectroscopy experiments. Despite tremendous experimental and theoretical progress since then, many issues remain unresolved, particularly in the lepton scattering field. In this talk, I will briefly review recent progress from lepton scattering experiments, with a focus on the high-precision proton charge radius experiment at Jefferson Lab (PRad). I will also introduce the recently approved PRad-II experiment, which aims to reduce the total uncertainty of rp by a factor of 4 compared to PRad. This new experiment will be able to push the precision frontier in electromagnetic interaction and contribute to new physics searches such as the violation of Lepton universality.
data.speakerBio: Weizhi Xiong is a professor at Shandong University. He attended the University of South Carolina, received a B. S. in physics in 2012, and earned a Ph.D. from Duke University in 2020. After graduation, he joined Syracuse University and worked as a postdoc researcher between 2020 and 2022. He is a co-spokesperson for three approved experiments at JLab. His research focuses mostly on nucleon structure, particularly high-precision measurements of the proton electric charge radius, nucleon electromagnetic form factors, parity-violating deep inelastic scattering, as well as software developments for SoLID spectrometer at JLab, and future Electron-Ion Collider in China (EicC).

data.abstract: 损失厌恶是最为普遍的决策偏好之一,但关于其背后的机制至今仍有争议。我们最近提出了损失厌恶的双维度理论,将损失厌恶分解为损失放大和损失回避这两个维度,并结合计算建模、眼动追踪、脑电波记录等方法揭示了这一理论框架的计算、认知与神经基础。最后,我们用损失厌恶的双维度理论为禀赋效应这一行为经济学中的经典悖论提供了一个全新的解释。

data.title: “庆祝建校九十周年和建院十周年”名家系列讲座-弭元元教授
data.topic: A Synaptic Story of Working Memory (工作记忆的突触理论)
data.speaker: 弭元元
data.speakerAffiliation: 重庆大学医学院神经智能研究中心
data.listTitle: “庆祝建校九十周年和建院十周年”名家系列讲座-弭元元教授
data.abstract: Working memory refers to the phenomenon that the brain can store and manipulate input information temporally, in order to carry out certain cognitive functions. The neural mechanism underlying working memory has been debated constantly in the field. The synapse-based theory proposes that rather than relying on persistent neuronal firings, the temporally facilitated synaptic strengths due to short-term synaptic plasticity (STP) can carry the memory trace of inputs and thus support working memory. In this talk, I will introduce two studies aligning with this STP-based theory. First, we built up a computational model to analyze the capacity of working memory and found that the model naturally predicts the capacity of 4~6, when the biological plausible parameters are used, and the model works in a way analogy to the theta-gamma oscillation. Secondly, we manipulated the synapse strengths via STP by applying external probe signals, and found that the memory retrieval performances predicted by the model agree very well with the experimental findings. Overall, our studies suggest that STP can serve as the neural mechanism for working memory.

data.topic: A priori error analysis and greedy training algorithms for neural networks solving PDEs
data.speaker: 洪庆国
data.listTitle: 学术报告-洪庆国
data.abstract: We provide an a priori error analysis for methods solving PDEs using neural networks. We show that the resulting constrained optimization problem can be efficiently solved using greedy algorithms, which replaces stochastic gradient descent. Following this, we show that the error arising from discretizing the energy integrals is bounded both in the deterministic case, i.e. when using numerical quadrature, and also in the stochastic case, i.e. when sampling points to approximate the integrals. This innovative greedy algorithm is tested on several benchmark examples to confirm its efficiency and robustness. 学术

data.title: 学术报告-孙澎涛
data.topic: Numerical PDEs for Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) Problems
data.speaker: 孙澎涛
data.listTitle: 学术报告-孙澎涛
data.abstract: The interaction of a flexible structure with a flowing fluid in which it is submersed or by which it is surrounded gives rise to a rich variety of physical phenomena with applications in many fields of engineering, named as fluid-structure interactions (FSI). To understand these phenomena, we need to find an effective way to model and simulate both fluid and structure, simultaneously, by investigating the interaction between them. In general, FSI problems require the fluid and the structure fields at the common interface to share not only the same velocity but also the common traction force. There are currently several major approaches classified with respect to the numerical treatment how the interfacie conditions of FSI are dealt with on the moving interface. In my talk, I will introduce three numerical techniques studied in my research for solving FSI problems: (1) body fitted mesh (arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian) method, (2) body-unfitted mesh (fictitious domain) method, and (3) meshfree (deep neural network) method. Our applications to FSI problems range from hydrodynamics (physics) to hemodynamics (biology, physiology), in which the involved structures are either incompressible or compressible and bear a deformable and/or rotational constitutive relation while the surrounding fluid flow is incompressible or nearly incompressible. In particular, our well-developed numerical methods have been successfully applied to several realistic dynamic FSI problems. Some belong to the hydrodynamics that involve a deforming and/or spinning turbine which is immersed in the fluid flow. Others belong to the hemodynamical applications, e.g., a rotating artificial heart pump inside the artery to help on curing the heart−failure patients, and an intravascular stent inside the blood fluid to treat the aneurismal patients. Both applications are to improve the human cardiovascular system and to remedy cardiovascular diseases. Some animations will be shown in this talk to illustrate that the proposed and well analyzed numerical methods can produce high fidelity numerical results for realistic FSI problems in an efficient and accurate fashion. 学术
data.speakerBio: 孙澎涛博士,现任美国内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校(University of Nevada Las Vegas, UNLV) 数学系的终身正教授,博士生导师。1997 年在中国科学院数学研究所获博士学位。在 2007 年入职美国内华达大学(UNLV)之前,曾先后在中国科学院、香港理工大学、美国宾夕法尼亚州立大学、加拿大西蒙弗雷泽大学担任博士后、副研究员、助理教授等职位。主要研究方向:偏微分方程数值解,有限元/有限体积方法的数值分析,自适应有限元方法,区域分解方法,相场方法, 以及对流体动力学、固体力学、流─固耦合动力学、燃料电池动力学、血液动力学、电流体动力学等多物理场问题的建模、科学与工程计算的算法、分析、实现等研究。在著名的科学期刊上发表学术论文 100 余篇。2008 年以来的研究课题连续被美国国家科学基金会(NSF),西蒙斯基金会(Simons Foundation)和内华达大学的教授研究奖励基金所资助。于 2016 年获得内华达大学理学院颁发的杰出研究奖。

data.title: “庆祝建校九十周年和建院十周年”名家系列讲座-李敏维博士
data.topic: 文化在塑造人们对环境问题的反应中的作用
data.speaker: 李敏维
data.listTitle: “庆祝建校九十周年和建院十周年”名家系列讲座-李敏维博士
data.abstract: 虽然解决不断加剧的环境问题需要全球范围内的集体努力,但最近的证据表明,全球对环境的关注有所下降。因此,研究并确定哪些因素会促进或破坏个人的环保倾向是至关重要的。一些人呼吁对社会文化背景如何影响个人对环境问题的反应这一问题进行更多研究。为了响应这些呼吁,李敏维博士将介绍几项跨文化研究,说明社会文化背景在预测人们对环境问题的反应中的重要作用。具体来说,我们研究了不同的社会文化因素(例如,辩证法和个人主义)在不同背景下对人们的亲环境倾向的影响。我们的研究结果发现,这些社会文化因素直接影响了人们的亲环境倾向,并调节了心理变量和亲环境倾向之间的联系强度。我们还发现,环境行为在家庭环境中的传递在不同文化中是不同的。我们的研究强调了在环境研究中考虑社会文化背景的重要性,这可能有助于在全球范围内更好地培养亲环境倾向。

data.title: 华师经管学术讲座第441 期（管理）
data.topic: To Stand Out or Fit In? How Perceived Overqualification Motivates Proactive and Affiliative Performance
data.speaker: 马超
data.speakerAffiliation: 澳大利亚国立大学商业与经济学院管理研究院
data.speakerBio: 马超博士在香港浸会大学获得工商管理学士学位(一等荣誉),在澳大利亚国立大学取得商业管理硕士和哲学硕士学位,并获得澳大利亚国立大学管理学博士学位,目前在澳大利亚国立大学商业与经济学院管理研究院担任讲师(助理教授), 澳大利亚国立大学亚澳领导力中心首席研究员。马超博士的研究领域包括人力资源管理和组织行为学,如领导力、资质过度感知、职业发展,以及绩效管理等课题。马超的研究成果发表在包括FT50管理学期刊以及澳大利亚ABDC-A*/A排名期刊等国际学术期刊:Human Resource Management, Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Business Research, Applied Psychology: An International Review, Personnel Review等.
data.abstract: Contributing to the literature on positive effects of overqualification, this research examines when and why perceived overqualification predicts affiliative and proactive performance at work. Integrating optimal distinctiveness theory with self-construal theory, we propose that depending on the nature of an employee's self-construal (i.e., independent, or interdependent), perceived overqualification will be associated with two opposing motivational processes—namely, differentiation and assimilation. We expect perceived overqualification to have a positive relationship with a motive for assimilation when an employee has a strong interdependent self-construal. Conversely, we expect perceived overqualification to have a positive relationship with a motive for differentiation when an employee has a strong independent self-construal. We further argue that assimilation seeking and differentiation seeking motives will be positively related to affiliative and proactive performance, respectively. We conducted two multi-waved and multi-sourced studies to test our hypotheses. In a pilot study (N = 249), we first tested our moderation hypothesis. In our main study (N = 496), we tested our overall moderated mediation model. Results from both studies reveal that perceived overqualification can trigger a need for differentiation or assimilation in employees depending on the nature of their self-construal. The differentiation seeking motive was positively related to proactive performance, while the assimilation seeking motive was positively related to affiliative performance. Our findings advance overqualification and motivation literatures and provide insights into talent acquisition and management.

data.topic: The Long Run Effect of Telegraph Construction on Innovation Collaboration
data.speaker: 吴明琴
data.abstract: We investigate the long-run impact of historical telegraph contruction on innovation collaboration across locations in mordern times. The empirical results show that the telegraph contruction before 1911 can increase innovation collaborations between firms in different cities by aorund 33% in the 2000s. To control for the endogeneity of telegraph route, we use the distance to the early military telegraph trunk as the instrument variable. This persistent long-run effect of telegraph can be attributed the channels of infrastructure investment and information transmission.

data.title: 南方科技大学黄文副研究员学术报告
data.topic: Quantum geometric effects in multi-orbital superconductors
data.speaker: 黄文
data.speakerAffiliation: 南方科技大学量子科学与工程研究院
data.listTitle: 南方科技大学黄文副研究员学术报告
data.abstract: The Bloch electrons in multi-orbital or multiband systems are not featureless particles. Instead, they generally possess quantum geometric information characteristic of their wavevector-dependent orbital composition. This property manifests in the electromagnetic responses, in the sense that the transport properties of the multiple Bloch electrons at the same wavevector are quantum mechanically interwoven by interband velocities --- quantities that are related to the non-Abelian Berry connection among those states. One part of the quantum geometry, the Berry curvature, has been discussed widely in the context of topological band theories. However, the other part, the quantum metric, which is actually more universally present in multiband systems, has received far less attention. Recently, it was realized that quantum metric is crucial for the existence of flatband superconductivity. This talk will focus on several more novel effects enabled by quantum geometry (mostly quantum metric) in multiband superconductors. We will discuss: A) how quantum geometry induces intrinsic optical anomaly and how this may be related to the anomalous high-frequency spectral change observed in some cuprate and iron-based superconductors; and B) how quantum geometry may facilitate the formation of pair-density-wave states.

data.abstract: 深度学习因其处理复杂任务和环境的强大能力而受到欢迎。各种算法和方法已经被设计用于在不同的人工智能领域和应用中,包括计算机视觉、自然语言处理和机器人控制。与此同时,深度学习技术的商业化促使攻击者有更强的动机去窃取模型,从而可能导致严重的版权侵犯和经济损失。这种模型窃取攻击在过去几年中已被广泛探讨。在本次报告中,我们将对现代深度学习技术面临的模型提取威胁提供新的见解。我们提出了新的攻击技术,用于窃取先进的深度强化学习模型、自动人工智能模型和鲁棒模型。这些方法强调了保护现代深度学习应用的重要性,并激发了更高效和安全的解决方案的灵感。

data.speaker: 黄正达
data.speakerAffiliation: 浙江大学数学科学学院
data.listTitle: 学术报告-黄正达
data.abstract: For saddle point problems, a two-parameter shift-splitting (TPSS) preconditioner is proposed. Estimated lower and upper bounds of the real eigenvalues and the real and imaginary parts of the non-real eigenvalues of the TPSS preconditioned matrix are obtained, respectively. As special cases, bounds obtained are tighter than the ones for the GSS, PGSS, IGSS and NESS preconditioners, respectively. Meanwhile, the corresponding TPSS iteration method is constructed and the convergence analysis is studied. Numerical experiments for two frequently used problems are given to illustrate the great robustness of the TPSS preconditioner. 学术

data.abstract: 近年来,智慧数据理论的提出与不断完善给数字人文领域带来了新的研究视角。正如"智慧"无边界,"智慧数据"也一直处于发展当中。如何来定义和理解智慧数据,又如何来实现智慧数据,一直是业内学者探索和思考的话题。今天我们将聚焦智慧数据,一起来探讨智慧数据背后的知识体系,以及思考如何将智慧数据应用于古籍智慧性保护、古籍互联互通平台构建和文化遗产图像资源建设的研究中。

data.abstract: 半导体探测器由于测量准确、集成度高、体积小等特性,被广泛运用在高能物理实验中。例如,欧洲核子中心的 LHC加速器是目前人类最大的强子对撞机,而ATLAS和CMS是其上的两个通用型探测器,而LHCb是专注于味物理的探测器。这些物理实验的共同点是利用半导体探测器测量高能带电粒子的飞行轨迹和衰变顶点。高空间分辨的顶点和径迹测量对于物理研究至关重要。

data.title: 中国科学院大学张啸天博士学术报告
data.topic: Ferromagnetic resonance as a novel probe for non-Fermi liquids and infinite critical boson non-Fermi liquids
data.speaker: 张啸天
data.listTitle: 中国科学院大学张啸天博士学术报告
data.abstract: Landau's Fermi liquid theory is the foundation of modern condensed matter physics. Strong correlation mediated by critical bosons renders Landau's quasiparticle picture broken down which amounts to a non-Fermi liquid (NFL) metal. Distinct types of NFLs can be classified according to the momentum carried by the critical boson. This leads to the ferromagnetic/anti-ferromagnetic quantum criticality and the NFL state in the associated quantum critical regime. In the first part of the talk, I will introduce a novel type of NFL induced by infinite many bosons that simultaneously become critical on a continuous manifold. This constitutes the scenario of infinity scatter infinity which is studied by complementary theoretical frameworks. The physical consequence for the infinite critical boson NFL is demonstrated in both three and two spatial dimensions.In the second part, I turn to the investigation of using ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) as a new probe for the strongly correlated phases of matter without quasiparticles. Properties of the NFL metallic phase can be read off from the modulations on the FMR. The characteristic frequency and temperature dependence of the FMR modulations is analytically derived for the Ising-nematic quantum criticality-induced NFL.
data.speakerBio: About the speaker: Dr. Xiao-Tian Zhang graduated from the School of Gifted Young at the University of Science and Technology of China in 2013. He received his Ph.D degree from the International Center for Quantum Materials at Peking University in 2019 under the supervision of Prof. Ryuichi Shindou. During 2019-2022, he worked in the group of Prof. Gang Chen at the University of Hong Kong as a postdoc. Starting in 2023, he joined the Kavli Institute for Theoretical Sciences, UCAS with a director’s postdoctoral fellowship.

data.abstract: 金属表面的化学反应在非均相催化以及纳米结构生长等复杂过程中都起着重要的作用。在较低的温度下,这些反应一般沿着最低能量路径进行。这时,温度效应可以通过谐振子模型描述。当反应温度很高甚至接近表面材料的熔点时,整个表面结构变得高度无序。这时,偏离最低能量路径的高能结构也十分重要。我们对高温反应的一般性规律目前还知之甚少。在本报告中,通过基于机器学习势的大规模分子动力学模拟,我们发现几种重要的高温效应,包括局域化学环境、表面原子迁移以及衬底材料热膨胀。这些效应对反应速率常数以及反应物和产物的平衡浓度和扩散率有不同的影响。这些结果加深了我们对高温表面化学反应的认识。

Am. Chem. Soc.、Phys. Rev. Lett.、Angew. Chem. Int. Ed.在内的国际学术期刊上发表论文200余篇,SCI引用8900余次,H因子为52。

data.title: 学术报告-杨丹丹
data.topic: Coherency for monoids and purity for their acts
data.speaker: 杨丹丹
data.listTitle: 学术报告-杨丹丹
data.abstract: In this talk, we study the relationship between coherency of a monoid and purity properties of its acts. An underlying motivation comes from the following question for an algebra: when does the guaranteed solution of a finite consistent set of equations in one variable lift to the guarantee of solutions of finite consistent sets equations in any (finite) number of variables? This is a long-standing and intriguing problem, with a positive answer for some algebraic structures (e.g. groups and semigroups) but not fully understood for modules over rings or acts over monoids. Our first main result shows that for a right coherent monoid $S$ the classes of almost pure and absolutely pure $S$-acts coincide. Our second main result is that a monoid $S$ is right coherent if and only if the classes of mfp-pure and absolutely pure $S$-acts coincide. We give specific examples of monoids $S$ that are not right coherent yet are such that the classes of almost pure and absolutely pure $S$-acts coincide. Finally we give a condition on a monoid $S$ for all almost pure $S$-acts to be absolutely pure in terms of finitely presented $S$-acts, their finitely generated subacts, and certain canonical extensions. 学术

data.abstract: The linear multiplicative programming problem arises from numerous applications such as network flows and financial optimization. The problem is first transformed into an equivalent nonlinear optimization problem to provide a novel convex quadratic relaxation. A simplicial branch-and-bound algorithm is then designed to globally solve the problem, based on the proposed relaxation and simplicial branching process. The convergence and computational complexity of the algorithm are also analyzed. 学术

data.listTitle: 学术报告-钟庆海
data.abstract: Sets of lengths in $H$ can be studied in the monoid of zero-sum sequences $\mathcal B (G)$ associated to $H$. A zero-sum sequence means a finite unordered sequence of group elements from $G$ (repetition is allowed) which sums up to zero. The set of zero-sum sequences forms a monoid where the operation is just the juxtaposition of sequences. This monoid $\mathcal B (G)$ is a Krull monoid again and its system of sets of lengths coincides with the system of our starting monoid $H$. 学术

data.topic: Seesaw Effective Field Theories and Renormalization-group Equations
data.speaker: 周顺
data.speakerAffiliation: 中科院高能物理研究所
data.listTitle: 周顺——Seesaw Effective Field Theories and Renormalization-group Equations
data.abstract: The discovery of neutrino oscillations reveals that neutrinos are massive and lepton flavor mixing exists. In this talk, I shall explain why and how we construct low-energy effective theories of canonical seesaw models at the one-loop level. The one-loop renormalization-group equations of physical parameters in the seesaw effective field theory are also derived. Such a construction provides us with a self-consistent framework for the low-energy precision tests of the seesaw models at high-energy scales.

data.speaker: 李嘉楠
data.speakerAffiliation: 厦门大学经济学院和王亚南经济研究院
data.speakerBio: 数据,涉及科研教育、医学、司法、工商业、文化文艺、行政和军事等领域。研究发现,科举废除后,拥有更高科举考试优势的地方产生了更多从事现代化职业的精英,并产生了更多的现代学科领域先驱。在考虑了潜在的测量误差和遗漏变量、洋务运动、传统职业精英、其他外生冲击等因素后,以上结论依然稳健。在机制部分,我们讨论并检验新式教育推广、留学经历和学习现代化学科的影响。我们的研究发现为理解人才配置制度的重要性以及中国如何从封闭的农业社会逐步吸收并建立现代知识体系提供了新的历史证据。
data.abstract: 人才配置(Talent allocation)制度对于一个国家的经济发展,特别是落后封闭的国家,具有重要的促进作用。近代中国在科举废除之后,传统进入仕途的科举功名被西式教育文凭所替代,极大鼓励了精英学子将学习内容从传统儒家经典配置向现代科学知识,促进了中国的近代化转型,为我们理解人才配置的重要性提供了独特的历史环境。在因果识别检验中,我们利用科举废除作为人才配置转变的外生冲击,从历史文档中手动整理并分析262个府1865-1900年出生的13101位精英简历数据,涉及科研教育、医学、司法、工商业、文化文艺、行政和军事等领域。研究发现,科举废除后,拥有更高科举考试优势的地方产生了更多从事现代化职业的精英,并产生了更多的现代学科领域先驱。在考虑了潜在的测量误差和遗漏变量、洋务运动、传统职业精英、其他外生冲击等因素后,以上结论依然稳健。在机制部分,我们讨论并检验新式教育推广、留学经历和学习现代化学科的影响。我们的研究发现为理解人才配置制度的重要性以及中国如何从封闭的农业社会逐步吸收并建立现代知识体系提供了新的历史证据。

data.title: 邢志忠——浅谈中微子的马约拉纳属性
data.topic: 浅谈中微子的马约拉纳属性
data.speaker: 邢志忠
data.speakerAffiliation: 中科院高能物理研究所
data.listTitle: 邢志忠——浅谈中微子的马约拉纳属性
data.abstract: 为什么绝大多数理论物理学家愿意相信中微子具有马约拉纳属性,即中微子的反粒子等于其自身？该属性可能产生哪些有趣的科学后果？为了回答这两个问题,报告将从粒子物理学标准模型的不自然性入手,探讨对该理论的最直接、最自然、最经济的扩充,以解释中微子的微小质量起源。人们则可发现,这一努力难免导致中微子的马约拉纳属性。后者会引发无中微子双贝塔衰变等轻子数破坏的过程,甚至可能破坏宇宙的原初物质与反物质之间的对称性。
data.speakerBio: 邢志忠, 1987年毕业于北京大学物理系,1993年获得中国科学院高能物理研究所博士学位。之后在慕尼黑大学和名古屋大学从事基本粒子物理学理论研究,2001年初回国。现任高能物理研究所二级研究员,理论物理研究室主任。国家杰出青年科学基金获得者,"新世纪百千万人才工程"国家级人选。主要从事费米子质量起源、CP对称性破坏和中微子物理学的理论研究,完成了多项有国际影响力的原创性工作。2008年应邀在第34届国际高能物理会议(美国费城)上做中微子理论的大会综述报告,2011年出版440页、70万字的英文专著《Neutrinos in Particle Physics、Astronomy and Cosmology》,系统地描述了中微子物理学、天文学和宇宙学的基础知识和最新进展。发表学术论文200余篇,总引用率超过10000次。业余时间热心科普创作,是中国科学家博客写作的先行者。

data.title: 第134期心理沙龙之余可可博士讲座
data.topic: 口语中的多重信息加工及相互影响
data.speaker: 余可可
data.listTitle: 第134期心理沙龙之余可可博士讲座
data.abstract: 口语交流是人际交往的重要方式。传统的口语研究主要探讨口语中的语言信息( linguistic information, 例如,语音和语义)。而近来,口语中的非语言信息( nonlinguistic information, 例如,说话者的身份)也逐渐受到重视。本次报告将首先介绍口语中的多重信息,然后介绍近期开展的三项相关工作:( 1 )说话者身份和语言信息加工的神经生理差异;( 2 )注意对说话者身份和语言信息加工的调节;( 3 )不同语言信息对说话者身份识别的影响。这些工作有助于进一步了解口语中多重信息的认知神经加工机制,发展经典的口语加工模型,为口语交流提供启发。
data.speakerBio: 余可可,华南师范大学心理学院特聘副研究员,中国心理学会学习心理专委会秘书。主要采用认知行为实验法、脑电技术和功能磁共振技术探讨言语感知与理解和口语学习等方面的研究。研究工作发表于 Language, Cognition and Neuroscience 、 Journal of Neurolinguistics 、 Psychophysiology 等国际期刊 。

data.speaker: Marc Cadotte
data.listTitle: 学术讲座：Functioning in a stressed world: understanding the interaction between anthropogenic stressors and biodiversity and ecosystem functioning
data.abstract: Human-caused change is altering biodiversity and ecosystem processes across spatial scales. Biodiversity is the foundation for the functioning of healthy ecosystems and for providing economic and other benefits to human wellbeing. Twenty years of experiments confirm such biodiversity-ecosystem function (BEF) relationships, but putting this research into real-world environmental change and management scenarios has been surprisingly limited. Environmental change drivers (hereafter referred to as stressors) can impact species differently, with positive, neutral, and negative impacts on their fitness, carrying capacity, interactions, and access to resources-and so predicting the impacts of multiple stressors on biodiversity and ecosystem functioning can be complex. In this talk, I examine how biodiversity influences ecosystem functioning, and then focus on how stressors alter species contributions to function and the nature of the relationship between biodiversity and ecosystem functioning. I use theoretical models to examine how the multiple stressors could impact BEF relationships, and then test this with experiments. I will then scale up these predictions to BEF patterns in different scenarios under anthropogenic stressors. I will end off with how this research can provide insights and guidance to studying and managing biodiversity in cities.

data.title: 杨海军——探索基本粒子质量起源之谜-希格斯玻色子的发现和未来希格斯工厂
data.topic: 探索基本粒子质量起源之谜 - 希格斯玻色子的发现和未来希格斯工厂
data.speaker: 杨海军
data.listTitle: 杨海军——探索基本粒子质量起源之谜-希格斯玻色子的发现和未来希格斯工厂
data.abstract: 粒子物理主要研究物质最深层次的结构,理解基本粒子的性质及其相互作用。 2012年欧洲核子中心CERN大型强子对撞机LHC实验上发现了希格斯玻色子,揭示了基本粒子质量起源之谜。希格斯玻色子的发现被美国《Science》杂志评为2012年度最重大的科学发现,为2013年度诺贝尔物理学奖提供了最关键的实验证据。希格斯玻色子的发现为粒子物理标准模型奠定了关键的基石,是粒子物理学的一个重大里程碑。标准模型在过去半个世纪取得了巨大的成功,但仍有许多重大问题有待解决,希格斯玻色子的发现为此提供了新的思路。希格斯玻色子作为探索超出标准模型新物理的探针,将对暗物质的质量起源、宇宙早期电弱相变、物质与反物质不对称等重大前沿科学问题提供新的研究手段和重要指引。 2020年,欧洲粒子物理战略规划将正负电子希格斯工厂列为优先级最高的下一代对撞机项目,2022年国际未来加速器委员会重申希格斯工厂最高优先级的国际共识。目前,国际高能物理学界提出了多个希格斯工厂方案。本报告将简要介绍粒子物理标准模型和"希格斯机制",回顾如何利用高能对撞机在实验上寻找和发现希格斯玻色子,展示近年来希格斯相关的亮点研究成果,重点介绍中国版希格斯工厂CEPC的研究进展及其前景！
data.speakerBio: 杨海军，上海交通大学物理与天文学院和李政道研究所教授，粒子与核物理研究所所长，上海市粒子物理和宇宙学重点实验室主任，中国环形正负电子对撞机 CEPC项目副主任。2000年获中国科学院高能物理研究所和瑞士联邦理工学院联合培养博士学位。2000-2012年在美国密歇根大学物理系历任博士后和研究科学家，2012年起受聘上海交通大学。长期从事高能对撞机实验研究，在希格斯玻色子的发现和性质联合测量，矢量玻色子散射过程的发现，以及最先提出多变量机器学习方法BDT并应用于粒子物理实验等方面做出重要贡献。曾参与欧洲核子中心(CERN)大型正负电子对撞机(LEP)的L3实验和美国费米实验室的MiniBooNE实验。目前参与大型强子对撞机的ATLAS实验(2005-)和中国高能环形正负电子对撞机CEPC预研（2012-）。

data.abstract: In this article, we develop a valid framework for inference of ultra-high dimensional quasi-likelihood models, based on a novel weighted estimation approach and a data splitting technique. data.abstract: It is of great importance to investigate the significance of a subset of covariates $W$ for the response $Y$ given covariates $Z$ in regression modeling. data.speaker: 刘彬
data.speakerAffiliation: 广东省新兴激光等离子体技术研究院
data.listTitle: 广东省新兴激光等离子体技术研究院刘彬研究员学术报告
data.abstract: 加速器能够将带电粒子加速到很高能量,从而在物理、医学、材料、工业等诸多领域具有不可替代的应用价值。迄今为止,约四分之一的诺贝尔物理学奖与加速器有关。目前全世界约有4万台加速器。随着科学技术的发展,人类需要更多、更强的加速器来满足更多的研究和应用需求。然而,传统射频加速器由于自身原理限制,尺寸规模随着加速能量的增加而增加,高能加速器往往是造价高昂的大科学装置。为改变这一现状,使加速器尺寸更小,造价更低,探索新加速原理迫在眉睫。目前最有希望的一个方向是利用超强激光和等离子体进行粒子加速。等离子体可以承载比传统加速器高几个量级的电场,因此,相比传统加速器,加速距离可以缩小几个量级。本报告将简要介绍相关基本原理,以及我们近期在激光离子加速方面的一些研究进展。
data.speakerBio: 刘彬,广东省新兴激光等离子体技术研究院研究员。2010年博士毕业于中国工程物理研究院。2010年至2013年在北京大学做博士后。2013年至2016年在北京应用物理与计算数学研究所做助理研究员。期间2015年作为洪堡学者赴德国慕尼黑大学工作,2018年加入德国亥姆霍兹重离子研究中心。2022年起就职于广东省新兴激光等离子体技术研究院。当前研究兴趣为基于激光和等离子体的粒子加速。曾在Physical Review Letters(PRL), Physical Review A, Physics of Plasma 等杂志发表学术论文约30篇,包括一篇PRL封面文章。主持过多项国内外重要科研项目,包括国家自然科学基金青年科学基金项目和德国高斯计算中心(GCS)的Large-Scale Project。

data.speaker: 李海中
data.listTitle: 学术报告-李海中
data.abstract: Since there is no universally acknowledged definition of the sum of two sets in hyperbolic space, there has been no Brunn-Minkowski theory in hyperbolic space since 1903. In this talk, for any p>0 we introduce a sum of two sets in hyperbolic space, and we call it the hyperbolic p-sum. Then we develop a Brunn-Minkowski theory in hyperbolic space by use of our hyperbolic p-sum, and we call it the horospherical p-Brunn-Minkowski theory. This is joint work with Botong Xu. 学术
data.speakerBio: 李海中,清华大学二级教授,博士生导师,国务院政府特殊津贴获得者。从事微分几何的研究工作,在 JDG, Crelle's Journal, Adv. Math., Math. Ann., Trans. AMS, Calc. Var. PDE, JFA, Comm. Math. Phys., Math Z.等数学期刊发表论文160余篇,论文被国内外同行引用2000余次。与澳大利亚国立大学Ben Andrews教授合作给出三维球面中常平均曲率嵌入环面的完全分类,完全解决了著名的Pinkall-Sterling猜想。李海中教授2018年荣获教育部自然科学一等奖,2019年荣获国家自然科学二等奖。

data.topic: The Persistent Impact of Biased Narratives:Evidence from an Online Experiment
data.speaker: 刘曼微
data.speakerBio: 刘曼微,荷兰蒂尔堡大学经济学博士,现任南京审计大学讲师。研究领域主要为行为与实验经济学,目前的研究兴趣聚焦于社会互动中制度的内生以及观点的形成。
data.abstract: Can people counteract biased narratives---the qualitative interpretation of objective facts or events---through subsequent information acquisition? Using an online experiment, we investigate this question by first randomly assigning participants to read different narratives that contain the same facts, and then offering them the opportunity to acquire more balanced arguments. We document three main findings. First, participants shift their attitudes towards the standpoint of the randomly assigned narrative, knowing that the narrative is biased and randomly assigned. Second, the opportunity to read additional arguments does not prompt participants to adjust their attitudes shaped by the original narrative. Third, when evaluating subsequent arguments, participants see arguments aligned with the randomly assigned narrative as more convincing, which likely contributes to their inability to counteract biased narratives. Taken together, our results demonstrate a persistent effect of biased narratives in a setting where counteracting is given the best chance.

data.abstract: 基于机器学习的脑影像分析可以将抽象的脑功能活动映射为参数化的表示,从而为更好地认识和理解大脑的工作机制提供见解。先验知识可以引导机器学习模型聚焦于与任务最相关的关键特征,规避无关特征的影响,从而提高模型对复杂特征的学习效率和表示能力。本次报告将围绕脑影像分析过程中所面临的实际问题,提出一系列认知神经科学领域先验知识赋能的机器学习模型 ,旨在通过先验知识的引导或约束来改善由于数据噪声或标注数据不足所导致的局部特征坍塌,从而提高机器学习模型在脑影像分析任务中的效果和性能。

data.topic: Entanglement Distribution – Towards a Suburban Quantum Network Link
data.speaker: 周忆如慕
data.listTitle: 慕尼黑大学周忆如学术报告
data.abstract: Heralded entanglement between distant quantum memories is one of the building blocks for quantum networks, which will enable secure quantum communication and distributed quantum computing. To this end, we developed a quantum network link employing entanglement shared between two independently trapped Rb-87 atoms located in buildings 400 m apart. The atoms can be entangled over fibre links with a length of up to 33 km, enabled by mitigating attenuation losses in the long fibres via polarization-preserving quantum frequency conversion. Decoherence of the atomic states reduced the observed atom-atom state fidelity for long fibre lengths. To overcome this, we implemented a state-selective Raman transfer to transfer the qubit encoding into one with significantly lower sensitivity to fluctuating magnetic fields. As a result, we improved the coherence time from 300 us to 7 ms. This robust qubit encoding enabled the distribution of atom-photon entanglement over 101 km telecom fibre with a fidelity ≥70.8%.This lays the ground for the next steps generating heralded entanglement between a single atom at LMU in Munich and a single atom at MPQ in Garching – approximately 14 km line-of-sight apart.

data.speakerAffiliation: 香港理工大学应用数学系
data.listTitle: 学术报告-许左权
data.abstract: This paper is concerned with a stochastic linear-quadratic optimal control problem with regime switching, random coefficients, and cone control constraint. The randomness of the coefficients comes from two aspects: the Brownian motion and the Markov chain. Using Itô's lemma for Markov chain, we obtain the optimal state feedback control and optimal cost value explicitly via two new systems of extended stochastic Riccati equations (ESREs). We prove the existence and uniqueness of the two ESREs。 学术
data.speakerBio: 许左权博士先后于南开大学、北京大学、香港中文大学获得本科、硕士、博士学位,曾任英国牛津大学数学研究所任野村金融数学研究员,并兼任牛津Oxford-Man研究所通讯研究员。现任教于香港理工大学应用数学系,主要从事金融数学理论研究,包括量化行为金融学、投资组合、保险契约理论等研究领域,多次于世界著名学术机构及学术会议上作学术报告,主持过多项国家自然科学基金及香港研究资助局项目。其主要学术成果发表在《Mathematical Finance》,《Annals of Applied Probability》,《Finance and Stochastics》,《SIAM Journal on Financial Mathematics》,《Quantitative Finance》,《Insurance: Mathematics and Economics》等著名国际学术期刊上。许博士现为著名国际期刊《Mathematics of Operations Research》编委。

data.abstract: 在强激光与物质相互作用的研究中,通常情况下,因为激光束包含大量的光子,可以证明在这种情况下光场的量子电动力学效应可以忽略,从而可用经典电磁场来描述激光。近四十年的强场电离等研究大都是在这个近似下展开的。虽然我们经常讲多光子电离,实质上,我们的研究基础是基于经典电磁场的,并没有光子的概念,严格讲没有考虑光子数的影响。考虑到过去几十年激光技术的显著进步,特别是实验精度的逐渐提高,研究光场的光子数对各种强场过程的影响变得非常有意义。本次报告将简单介绍我们近期基于量子电动力学的关于强场中原子的电离、多光子Compton散射的研究,定量地回答在给定激光场强度下,激光光子数是如何影响这些过程的。

data.title: 华师经管学术讲座第436期（管理）
data.topic: Feeling Possessive, Performing Well? Effects of Job-Based Psychological Ownership on Territoriality, Information Exchange, and Job Performance
data.speaker: 陈星汶
data.speakerBio: 陈星汶,复旦大学管理学院助理教授,研究兴趣包括组织领地性、领导力和团队。相关研究成果发表在 Journal of Applied Psychology, Human Resource Management, Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Occupational and Organizational Psychology, Personnel Psychology 等本专业国际知名期刊。
data.abstract: Job-based psychological ownership arises when workers develop personal feelings of possession over various aspects of a job. Drawing on conservation of resources and regulatory focus theory, the current research adopts a resource-based perspective to suggest a double-edged effect on job performance, mediated by three forms of territoriality (marking, defending, expanding) and information exchange and moderated by individual regulatory focus. With a multistep process in Study 1, the authors develop and validate a territorial expanding scale. Among 358 employee–supervisor dyads, Study 2 tests the proposed model; job- based psychological ownership prompts employees to engage in territorial marking, defending, and expanding. Territorial defending correlates negatively with information exchange, territorial expanding is positively related to it, and territorial marking has no relationship with information exchange. Information exchange is positively related to job performance. Job-based psychological ownership impedes job performance through increased territorial defending and reduced information exchange, especially among employees with a prevention focus. It enhances job performance through increased territorial expanding and increased information exchange, particularly if employees have a high promotion focus. These findings have notable implications for research and practice.

data.abstract: In this talk, we are concerned with a class of singularly perturbed elliptic problems in an annulus with supercritical growth. By virtue of a reduction argument, we show that there exists a nodal solution with exactly two positive and two negative peaks, which concentrates on two different orthogonal spheres. In particular, we establish different concentration phenomena of four peaks depending on the parameter. This talk is based on a joint work with Zhisu Liu and Juncheng Wei. 学术

data.speakerBio: 李大西博士为美国国际华人科技工商协会主席,美国凯思比海外创业投资公司董事长,中国全国政协海外特邀代表,中国侨联海外委员。 李大西1948年出生于广东省普宁县龙门村,1964年初中毕业于普宁二中,高中毕业于华南师院附中,1968-1972下乡回老家普宁县龙门村务农,当民办教师,1972-1975年在华南师院物理系学习,1978-1980年在中山大学物理系读研究生。 李大西1979年在李政道教授主持的美国物理研究生入学考试中获全国第二名,1980年到美国学习,1985年获美国纽约市大学物理博士。1987-1989年任加拿大麦基尔大学博士后研究员, 1987-1991任纽约市大学, 纽约理工学院研究员和副教授,在高能物理以及超弦理论研究方面做出一定贡献。1991年-2002年,任职于美国著名投资银行所罗门兄弟公司、雷曼兄弟公司, 参与多项重要IPO和风险投资项目,2003-2013年任美国东方银行董事。 于1997年发起组织国际华人科技工商协会(CASB)为科技与工商搭桥,为中国和世界搭桥。为应对亚洲金融危机,给朱镕基总理写了建议书,收到全国人大常委会的感谢函,组织协会专家为中国应付亚洲金融危机以及促进高新科技发展分别出了专书。1998年与中山大学,中国自然科学基金会,世界华人物理学会合作举办"科技与工商国际研讨会",与成思危副委员长,中山大学王珣章校长,章义朋教授任大会共同主席,对推动中国风险投资事业做出了一定贡献。1998年,协助广州市筹备全国首创的首届中国留学人员(广州)科技交流会,任筹委会副主任(林树森市长任筹委会主任),带领108美国留学人员回国参加会议。2000年与深圳市政府合资创办深圳留学生创业园,任副董事长,派出留学生任总经理,管理留学生创业园,已经成功孵化1000多留学生高科技企业和多个上市公司和独角兽企业。2005年作为海外特邀代表列席全国政协会议,写了建议书,提出了10点重要建议。李大西为促进中美友好,推动中国高新科技发展和金融改革做出相当的贡献,曾获习近平主席、江主席、胡主席、朱总理、温总理、李总理多次的亲切接见。 2008年起为应对世界金融危机,组织协会专家一起向中国有关领导提出建议。2009年起积极推动协会成员响应祖国召唤,回国创业,会见俞正声、张高丽、李源潮、汪洋、韩正等领导人,提出了建议,在推动中国可再生能源产业创新方面,做出相当贡献,共同创立了高空风能技术公司,研发高空风力发电技术。2011年10月在纽约,2013年12月在深圳,主持召开中美合作与创新峰会,讨论了中美合作,创新有较大影响。2013-2018年组织国际华人科技工商协会"中国梦"代表团访问广东、江苏、广西、新疆、安徽、河北、贵州、四川、江苏和陕西,受到热烈欢迎,会见了各省主要领导人,推动成立了深圳广大-康奈尔中美技术转移中心。在美国建立了纽约华尔街二号创投中心,培养创业创新人才。在深圳推动建立了微纳米芯片研究院。2019年在陕西与陕西省主要国企合资成立长安华科股份有限公司,打造综合性国际创新平台。2019年,2020年在西安与陕西省国资委、发改委、工商联等共同主办创新与合作国际论坛。 2022年组织国际华人科技工商协会代表团参加第一届中国数字经济大会,并发表视频演说。2023年2月在首届中国产业园区大会开幕式上发表视频演说,推动创新与合作。2023年3月底率领国际华人科技工商协会代表团访问上海,并在上海黄浦外滩论坛上发表演说推动做科创生态的催化者。2023年4月7日参加侨助汕头高质量发展大会,发表讲话。 物电学院迎90周年校庆系列活动之—杰出校友李大西先生讲座活动

data.speaker: 彦文娇
data.listTitle: 学术报告-彦文娇
data.abstract: It is a longstanding problem that whether there exists a complex structureon the 6-dimensional sphere? Many famous mathematicians have made effortson this problem, such as Hopf, Wen-tsun Wu, Borel, Serre, Shiing-shen Chern,Atiyah, etc. Taking advantage of isoparametric theory, we construct almostcomplex and complex structures on certain isoparametric hypersurfaces inthe unit sphere. As a consequence, a complex structure on the product of6-dimensional sphere and a closed 8-dimensional manifold is constructedalthough we don't know the existence of any complex structure on the 6-di-mensional sphere. Besides, a complex structure on the product of l-dimen-sional, 2-dimensional ,and 3-dimensional spheres with vanishing firstChern class are also built. This talk is based on joint work with ProfessorZizhou Tang.

data.speaker: 田林
data.speakerBio: 田林,复旦大学管理学院管理科学系教授/博士生导师。研究领域为面向平台供应链的运营决策问题,涉及电商平台、共享平台、在线服务平台等。研究成果发表在JMR、MKSC、MS、MSOM、OR、POM、管理科学学报等国际与国内知名期刊。主持国家自然科学基金优秀青年基金项目,同时主持或参与可口可乐(上海)、华为技术有限公司、华住集团、中国东方航空等多个企业项目。获第八届教育部人文社科青年成果奖,担任UTD期刊POM的Senior Editor。学术源于实践,学术应服务于实践,希望自己可以成为学术与实践之间联系的一根丝线。
data.abstract: The digital content market has grown dramatically in recent years. Many platforms show ads when consumers watch the content on their platforms, and they share ad revenue with content creators to incentivize them to create and share content. These platforms generally adopt either a uniform-advertising format or a differentiated-advertising format. This paper shows that, regardless of the ad format, an increase in substitutability of content creators on the platform can increase the content creators' profits and the consumer surplus. By contrast, an increase in substitutability of content creators can benefit the platform under uniform advertising but not under differentiated advertising. Moreover, the equilibrium ad revenue-sharing rate, content quality, and the number of ads shown for each content will be lower under differentiated advertising than under uniform advertising. The platform's profit and the consumer surplus are also lower under differentiated advertising than under uniform advertising. However, depending on the substitutability of content creators, the content creators' profits can be higher or lower under differentiated advertising. In an extension, we also analyze an emerging ad format in which the platform allows content creators themselves to decide the number of ads on their content. Interestingly, we show that this new ad format can make all the market participants (i.e., the platform, the content creators, and the consumers) worse off.

data.title: 深圳理工大学丁峰教授学术报告
data.topic: 用于指导材料生长实验设计的理论开发
data.speaker: 丁峰
data.speakerAffiliation: 深圳理工大学材料学院
data.listTitle: 深圳理工大学丁峰教授学术报告
data.abstract: 到目前为止,虽然我们已经有成熟的材料生长理论,材料制备仍然是一个非常依赖于经验的学科,这也导致一个新材料开发的周期通长达20-30年,甚至更长。为了缩短新材料的开发周期,我们课题组在过去20年内致力于材料生长机制,开发可以用于指导材料生长的理论的研究。本次报告我将主要介绍我们课题组过去在低维材料生长机制方面取得的一系列标志性的理论成就,以及这些理论在材料生长实验中的应用,包括:(1)开发可以用于指导实验设计的理论的多尺度计算方案。(2)我们对碳纳米管生长机制的理解与碳纳米管的可控合成,包括碳纳米管的成核理论,生长动力学,结构选择碳纳米管的制备方法。(3)我们对石墨烯和其它二维材料生长机制的理解与二维大单晶的制备,包括二维材料外延生长理论,制备二维大单晶的方法和实验实现。最后我将介绍在AI时代,开发材料生长过程模拟和材料生长机制理论的可行性与方案。并介绍在关键材料,包括单晶硅,GaN,SiC,金刚石等,合成中的更广泛的应用。
data.speakerBio: 丁峰教授在2002年获得南京大学物理学博士学位,在2003到2008年期间在瑞典哥德堡大学和美国莱斯大学做博士后与访问学者研究。2009年作为助理教授加入香港理工大学。2013年晋升为终身制副教授。2017年加入韩国蔚山科技学院任杰出教授并兼任韩国基础科学研究院多维碳材料中心理论组课题组长。自2017年起获得韩国基础科学研究院固定经费每年150万美元的研究经费资助。2022年底加入筹建中的深圳理工大学任讲座教授,并兼职加入中科院深圳先技术研究院的碳中和所与材料所,目前在筹建智慧材料研究中心。 丁峰教授的课题组多年来专注于低维材料生长机制的研究,开发了多种适用于模拟材料动力学过程的方法与软件。丁峰教授所提出的低维材料生长机制理论目前已得到国际学术界的广泛认可,并产生了广泛的国际影响,在材料生长机制探索领域处于国际领先地位。丁峰教授共发表SCI论文超320篇,其中IF > 10的论文超过一半,包括Nature/Science (8), Nat. Mater./Nat. Nano./Nat. Chem. (9), Nat. Comm./Sci. Adv./PNAS/JACS/PRL (37) 等。这些论文目前被SCI引用超17000次。

data.abstract: To enhance the estimate of the marginal outcome distribution, the conditional distribution of an outcome variable given covariates can be used. In this article, we propose two novel marginal quantile and mean estimation approaches through conditional quantile regression when some of the outcomes are missing at random. The first approach doesn't require the choice of a propensity score. The second is double robust and consistent, and extensive simulation studies demonstrate its utility. 学术

data.abstract: A new optimal weighting based on cross-validation method is developed for count data with overdispersion and/or excess zeros. The method includes the zero-inflated negative binomial model. A K-fold cross-validation technique is used to select the optimal weight vector. The method enhances computational efficiency by deleting one group of observations instead of one observation. The proposed method is superior to three commonly used methods on simulation studies and empirical applications. 学术

data.title: 学术报告-何炳生
data.topic: 用普通的大学数学做出简单统一的优化方法 --- 从华罗庚的"牢记把方法交给群众"谈起
data.speaker: 何炳生
data.listTitle: 学术报告-何炳生
data.abstract: 最优化方法是最接地气的应用数学,科学与工程计算中出现的许多优化问题都可以归结为一个变分不等式。听起来比较陌生的变分不等式其实就是"瞎子爬山判别是否到达顶点"的数学表达式。利用普通的大学数学和一般的优化原理,以变分不等式为基本工具,我们做出一些被国际同行知名学者誉为"Very Simple yet Powerful"和"Elegant"的工作。我们给出的算法统一框架,收敛性证明主要依靠一个初等的积化和差的恒等式,利用一些分块矩阵的知识,就可以相当容易地设计出一簇凸优化的分裂收缩方法。我们的研究实践再一次证明,简单的方法,才比较容易被工程界采用,转化成生产力。 学术
data.speakerBio: 何炳生,南京大学数学系77 级本科毕业后公派去联邦德国留学,师从巴伐利亚科学院院士Stoer,1987 年回国工作。在职期间,获江苏省科技进步一等奖。退休后,2014 年获《中国运筹学会科学技术奖》运筹研究奖,2016年获首届《江苏省工业与应用数学》突出贡献奖,2018年获《高等学校科学研究优秀成果奖》自然科学二等奖。长期从事最优化理论与方法的研究,在投影收缩算法和以ADMM为代表的分裂收缩算法等领域做出了一批有特色的工作,提出了一个简单的用来指导设计凸优化分裂收缩算法的统一框架。

data.title: 第132期心理沙龙之王碧瑶教授讲座
data.topic: 学业成就中的遗传养育效应
data.speaker: 王碧瑶
data.listTitle: 第132期心理沙龙之王碧瑶教授讲座
data.abstract: 父母与其子女在学业成就中的相似性可能来源于基因遗传的作用或通过抚养教育的影响。最新的研究表明,即使是父母未遗传给后代的基因仍通过环境的中介作用非直接地影响其发展,这一现象被称为"遗传养育"。该研究通过多层随机效应模型整合了来自不同样本来源与文化背景的关于遗传养育效应在教育中作用的证据,得出了普适的遗传养育效应效果量以及父母基因直接作用于后代对其结果的"直接遗传效应"效果量。检测了诸多变量的调节作用并证明了遗传养育效应超越样本来源、文化背景、基因来源(父亲 / 母亲)、研究设计等诸多方面影响的稳定性。验证了经济条件对于教育结果的重要调节作用,推论了父母未遗传给后代的基因影响其教育可能的中介因素。通过详尽的敏感性分析,充分证明了研究结果的可信度。同时,通过在开放科学平台预注册研究方案以及随文发表所有研究代码保证了研究的透明度及结果的可重复性。
data.speakerBio: 王碧瑶,华南师范大学心理学院副教授。主要研究方向为应用前沿的统计与测量方法进行大数据分析,通过潜变量建模、因果推断等方法探究心理学、精神病学以及教育学方面的问题。研究工作发表于 American Journal of Human Genetics 、 Journal of Clinical Medicine 、 European Child & Adolescent Psychiatry 等国际期刊。

data.topic: A Long Day at School: Paternalistic Education, Intrinsic Motivation and Academic Performance
data.speaker: 王睿新
data.speakerAffiliation: 哈尔滨工业大学(深圳)经济管理学院
data.speakerBio: 王睿新,现任哈尔滨工业大学(深圳)经济管理学院助理教授。先后获大连理工大学经济学学士 (2008年),香港科技大学经济学硕士 (2009年),荷兰蒂尔堡大学经济学博士(2015年)。曾任职香港浸会大学商学院,并在国际食物政策研究所(IFPRI)短期实习。他的主要研究领域为发展经济学与公共经济学。目前主持、参与了国家和省部级项目多项,2019年起,连续参与组织了多轮中国企业创新创业调查(ESIEC)。他的研究成果发表于Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization,The China Quarterly,International Tax and Public Finance,China Economic Review,经济学(季刊),经济科学等中英文一流期刊,并曾获工业与信息化部优秀研究成果一等奖(2022),首届中国劳动经济学者论坛年会(2016)最佳论文奖。
data.abstract: Paternalistic education is ubiquitous, particularly in East Asian countries. However, by influencing or constraining choices of students, paternalistic education may disempower students and "crowd out" their intrinsic motivation (Bénabou and Tirole, 2003). Using data from the China Education Panel Survey, this paper studies how paternalistic education at school shapes students' academic motivations and performances by estimating the effect of evening school session, which on average extends a school day to 14 hours and includes almost all study time within the control of school. We find that evening school session significantly reduces students' test scores and self-assessed scores, especially in Chinese and English. Additionally, evening school session undermines students' intrinsic motivation for study, and creates mental health issues. We identify causal inferences by exploiting the variation in sunset time and boarding status and discuss alternative interpretations. Furthermore, we find that the negative impacts of evening schooling sessions are particularly strong when the students are exposed to teachers who face more pressure from teaching evaluation, student promotion rate and school administration.

data.topic: Quantifying the threshold phenomena for propagation in nonlocal diffusion equations
data.location: 数科院西楼二楼会议室

data.speakerAffiliation: 天津大学应用数学中心

data.abstract: We are interested in the threshold phenomena for propagation in nonlocal diffusion equations with some compactly supported initial data. In the so-called bistable and ignition cases, we provide the first quantitative estimates for such phenomena. The outcomes dramatically depend on the tails of the dispersal kernel and can take a large variety of different forms. The strategy is to combine sharp estimates of the tails and the construction of accurate sub- and super-solutions. 学术

data.title: 中山大学马飞副教授学术报告
data.topic: 铌酸锂非线性光学频率转换
data.speaker: 马飞
data.listTitle: 中山大学马飞副教授学术报告
data.abstract: 铌酸锂被称为“非线性光学中的硅材料”，被广泛应用在频率转换和光通信方面。应对量子技术发展中经常遇到的波长不一致问题，我们采用反质子交换波导技术，研制了绝对转换效率为70%的周期性极化铌酸锂波导，构造了从1微米到2微米的一系列常见波段的上转换单光子探测器，应用在量子激光雷达和京沪干线上。借助于高效率的频率转换器件，我们实现了50公里光纤距离的静态纠缠分发，为实用化量子中继器和量子网络的构建奠定了基础。利用集成化的频率转换器件，我们演示了频差为150THz的不同颜色的强度干涉仪，超越了经典探测器的时间分辨率，拓宽了天文观测条件。此外，近年来随着铌酸锂薄膜的兴起，铌酸锂集成光路被誉为未来可以推动光子学革命的技术，本报告对这方面的研究进展也做部分介绍。
data.speakerBio: 马飞,2018年在中国科学技术大学获得博士学位,随后在香港城市大学做博士后研究,2020年任中山大学副教授。近年来,围绕周期性极化铌酸锂波导,致力于发展高效率的光学频率转换器件,并应用在量子通信领域,成果发表在Nature、Physical Review Letters、Optics Express等刊物上。

data.title: 学术报告-黄泽军
data.topic: An extremal problem on digraphs
data.speaker: 黄泽军
data.listTitle: 学术报告-黄泽军
data.abstract: Let $n$ and $k$ be integers larger than or equal to 2. Let $D$ be a simple digraph on $n$ vertices such that $D$ does not contain two distinct walks of length $k$ with the same initial vertex and the same terminal vertex. What is the maximum size of $D$? This problem is equivalent to the following: what is the maximum number of ones in an $n\times n$ matrix $A$ such that both $A$ and $A^k$ are 0-1 matrices? In this talk, we will present the solution to this problem. This talk is based on joint work with Zhenhua Lyu, Pu Qiao and Xingzhi Zhan. 学术

data.abstract: Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs on $n$ vertices with adjacency matrices $A(G)$ and $A(H)$, respectively. $G$ and $H$ are \emph{commuting graphs} if there exists a permutation matrix $P$ such that $A(G)$ and $P^TA(H)P$ commutes. data.abstract: 基于编码的公钥密码能有效抵抗量子计算机的攻击已经成为后量子公钥密码的重要类型之一，绝大多数基于编码的公钥方案的安全性是基于校验子译码困难问题。 校验子译码问题的实际安全性是指抵抗现有的各种攻击的能力，精准地估计相应的公钥密码方案的具体安全性和选择方案的参数集。因此本报告的主要内容是介绍目前求解校验子译码问题最好的通用算法——信息集合译码算法的发展历史、一般框架、关键技术点以及重要的信息集合译码算法--MMT算法。

data.topic: Nuclear excitation by electron capture
data.speaker: 吴远彬
data.listTitle: 吴远彬——Nuclear excitation by electron capture
data.abstract: Nuclear excitation by electron capture (NEEC) 是核物理与原子物理交叉领域的基本过程。在该物理过程中,原子核的激发由离子俘获自由电子到原子轨道所驱动。NEEC于1976年在理论上被提出,首个NEEC实验迹象于2018年被报道,相关的研究在基础物理研究与工业应用研究都引起了比较广泛的兴趣,涉及高密度天体环境、加速器和重离子储存环、以及激光等离子体等诸多物理环境,在核结构研究、高密度天体环境中核能级分布等基础研究领域具有重要研究价值,在触发同核异能素能量释放以及驱动核钟能级跃迁等方面具有工业应用的潜力。当前, NEEC研究的关键是实现对NEEC的明确的观测以及NEEC效率的有效提高。本报告从激光等离子体条件下的NEEC、首个NEEC实验迹象的讨论、以及涡旋电子束对NEEC过程的影响等方面进行探讨。
data.speakerBio: 吴远彬,南开大学物理科学学院教授。 2008年、2011年毕业于南开大学获学士学位和硕士学位,2014年毕业于意大利罗马大学获博士学位,2014年至2022年期间在德国马克斯普朗克核物理研究所从事研究工作,2022年入职南开大学。主要从事强激光驱动的核物理与天体物理的理论研究,研究兴趣涉及核物理、天体物理、强场物理等领域。

data.title: 华师经管学术讲座第431期（经济）
data.topic: Trade, Human Capital, and Income Risk
data.speaker: 邓留纯
data.speakerBio: Liuchun Deng is an assistant professor of economics at Yale-NUS College. His research focuses on the labor market and productivity consequences of automation and international trade. He also works on the theory of economic dynamics with applications to development, political economy, and trade. He is currently an associate editor of Economics of Transition and Institutional Change. Liuchun Deng holds a Ph.D. in Economics from Johns Hopkins University.
data.abstract: In this paper, we empirically assess the causal links between trade and individual income risk and study the role that human capital plays in this relationship using a rich,worker-level, longitudinal data set from Germany spanning the years 1976 to 2012. Our estimates suggest substantial heterogeneity in labor income risk across workers in different entry cohorts, over workers' life cycles, and across workers with different levels of industry-and occupation- specific human capital. Accounting for entry-cohort effects and age effects, our findings suggest that within-industry changes in imports and exports (per worker) are causally related to income risk: Imports increase risk and exports decrease risk, and they do so in an economically significant manner. Importantly, we find there to be a complex interplay between human capital and the linkage between trade and risk: While, on average, individuals with higher levels of industry- or occupation-specific human capital experience lower income risk, a given increase in net-imports exposure in an industry increases risk for workers with higher levels of industry tenure more than it does for workers with lower levels of industry tenure. High levels of industry-specific human capital can therefore be costly, from a risk perspective, for workers in highly trade-exposed industries. By contrast, we find no evidence of any interaction between risk, industry trade exposure, and occupation-specific human capital.

data.topic: Frobenius problem associated with the number of solutions
data.speaker: TAKAO KOMATSU
data.listTitle: 学术交流-TAKAO KOMATSU
data.abstract: Consider the number d(n;a_1,\dots,a_k) of non-negative integer solutions (x_1,\dots,x_k) of the linear diophantine equation n=a_1 x_1+\dots+a_k x_k, where a_1,\dots,a_k are positive integers. For a non-negative integer p, let S_p be the set of all n's such that d(n;a_1,\dots,a_k)>p. Then the set N_0\S_p is finite if and only if gcd(a_1,\dots,a_k)=1. The largest element and the cardinality of N_0\S_p are called the p-Frobenius number and the p-genus (p-Sylvester number), respectively. When p=0, the study on S=S_0 with the (0-)Frobenius number and the (0-)genus is known as the famous linear diophantine problem of Frobenius. In this talk, these backgrounds, tools and recent results for p>0 are given. 学术
data.speakerBio: TAKAO KOMATSU教授是浙江理工大学特聘教授。他在数论和组合方面的许多问题都有独到的见解,已发表论文210多篇。他是组合恒等式方面国际上著名专家。

data.speaker: 叶堉
data.listTitle: 北京大学叶堉研究员学术报告
data.abstract: 后摩尔时代的半导体电子技术需要不断寻找新的技术解决方案将器件尺寸缩小到原子级别,同时寻找新的架构为半导体器件增加更多功能。由于其原子级厚度和可堆叠性,二维(2D)半导体材料有望打破传统硅基半导体单一逻辑单元层的限制,实现新的半导体芯片制造技术。通过理解1T'到2H-MoTe2的固-固相变机制,我们通过种子诱导的二维平面外延工艺实现了2H-MoTe2单晶晶圆的可控制备。此外,我们开发了精准控制掺杂的二维半导体2H-MoTe2的制备方法。掺杂晶圆可进一步通过直接异质外延在任意单晶衬底上或者任意三维架构上,不受晶格匹配和平面基底的限制,适用于多层级制备。精准的p型和n型掺杂和异质集成,使二维半导体的层间互连集成电路的实现更近了一步。
data.speakerBio: 叶堉,北京大学物理学院研究员、博士生导师。2012年获得北京大学博士学位,2012-2016年在加州大学伯克利分校从事博士后研究工作。2016-至今任北京大学物理学院研究员(国家级青年人才),2022年获长聘职位。目前课题组(http://faculty.pku.edu.cn/yeyu/)主要研究方向为高质量二维半导体材料的可控制备,利用低温强磁场下的光谱和电磁输运技术研究二维材料及其异质结构的新奇物理特性,并构建相关器件。近年来,发表通讯或第一作者论文包括Science (2)、Nature Nanotechnology (3)、Nature Electroincs、Nature Synthesis、Nature Photonics、Nature Communications (3)、PRX、PRL、JACS 在内的科学论文100余篇,引用超过7300次,h因子为40。

data.speaker: 梁文泉
data.speakerBio: 梁文泉,现为暨南大学经济学院副教授。研究领域为城市劳动经济学,主要关注移民、户籍和城市发展。目前已经在 Journal of Environmental Economics and Management、China Economic Review、Journal of Housing Economics等国际期刊以及《中国社会科学》、《经济研究》、《管理世界》、《经济学(季刊)》等国内期刊发表论文多篇,研究成果曾获经济学(季刊)年度最佳论文、第十四届上海青年经济学者优秀成果一等奖。
data.abstract: In many countries around the world, migration costs and housing supply restrictions interact with each other and combine to restrict workers' location decisions. Using an equilibrium sorting model and rich micro data from China, we evaluate the impacts of these dual constraints on workers' sorting behavior and quantify the resulting changes in aggregate welfare and inequality. We find strong policy interactions between the two kinds of frictions in determining welfare losses and regional inequality. Counterfactual simulations show that lowering migration costs can increase welfare and reduce regional inequality by moving workers from unproductive inland regions to productive coastal regions in China; such welfare and regional distributional impacts depend on the elasticity of housing supply in coastal regions and vice-versa. Results highlight the policy complementarities between reducing the two kinds of frictions and have general implications for countries with different levels of constraints on mobility and housing supply.

data.title: 第131期心理沙龙之张光耀博士讲座
data.topic: 外侧颞叶在语义加工中的功能:社会语义工作记忆假设
data.speaker: 张光耀
data.speakerAffiliation: 北京师范大学认知神经科学与学习国家重点实验室
data.listTitle: 第131期心理沙龙之张光耀博士讲座
data.abstract: 语言加工和社会认知对人类生存和发展具有重要意义，二者之间存在密切的关系。但在过去，研究者常将它们作为不同领域来研究。近期越来越多的证据显示，二者的神经关联在左侧颞顶联合区腹侧（以下简称“vTPJ”）和左侧颞叶前部外侧（以下简称“lATL”）存在重叠。这提示上述脑区的神经活动可能与语言和社会认知的共同认知成分有关。然而，关于这两个脑区的实验结果，语言和社会领域分别将其解释为参与了“一般性的语义和句法加工”以及“社会语义的激活”。对此，我们提出了一种新的理论假设，认为vTPJ和lATL上发现的语言和社会效应能够通过同一种认知成分——社会语义工作记忆的加工来解释。本次讲座中，我将分享我们针对该假设开展的若干实证研究，以及得到的相关支持证据。
data.speakerBio: 张光耀,北京师范大学博士后, 2017 年本科毕业于南开大学, 2022 年博士毕业于中国科学院心理研究所。研究主要采用行为实验、磁共振成像等技术考察概念表征、概念加工和概念学习的认知神经机制。在 Scientific Data, Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience, Brain Structure & Function 等 SCI/SSCI 一区期刊发表多篇文章。

data.title: 中科院生物物理研究所胡一南学术报告
data.topic: 小型化光量子磁力计与新型脑功能成像设备
data.speaker: 胡一南中
data.speakerAffiliation: 中科院生物物理研究所
data.listTitle: 中科院生物物理研究所胡一南学术报告
data.abstract: 新型脑功能成像设备(尤其脑磁图MEG,超极化核磁共振MRI)对超高灵敏度磁场探测技术的需求推动了小型化光量子磁力计在灵敏度、集成度和稳定性上的不断提升。本报告将从物理学原理,实验构建以及工程化实现这三个方面来介绍小型化光量子磁力计,并在应用方面,结合背景磁场精准控制和环境磁场抑制技术,讲解如何将光量子磁力计应用于脑磁图,使新型脑磁图既具备传统脑磁图高敏感度、可做全脑高时空分辨率神经记录的优势,又突破性地实现成本的降低和可穿戴功能。此外,本报告还将介绍如何利用超低磁场下的高绝对场均匀性,将小型化高灵敏光量子磁力计应用于测量超极化样品的极化率,在基于仲氢诱导的超极化系统上将样品制备与检测结合,这对于利用超极化核磁共振技术对脑的代谢状态进行监测具有重要意义。
data.speakerBio: 胡一南,于2016年在中科院高能物理研究所取得硕士学位,同年担任中科院生物物理所脑磁图工程师。2017年赴德国亥姆霍兹研究所(美因茨)攻读博士,师从原子磁力计技术开拓者加州大学伯克利分校教授Dmitry Bukder,2021年取得德国亥姆霍兹研究所以及美因茨大学原子物理学博士学位,同年博士后出站回国。现为中科院生物物理研究所高级技术专家,正高级工程师。胡一南老师参与搭建了国内第一台科研用超导量子干涉仪(SQUID)脑磁图系统,开发了高灵敏度原子磁力计(OPM),并对其进行小型化实用化研究;搭建了基于OPM的生物磁检测系统、锂离子电池检测系统、零场核磁共振检测系统等多种非接触检测系统;进行了新型激光稳频技术研究,简化OPM结构,提升OPM性能;并开展了基于OPM的纳米磁颗粒检测技术的探索,以及应用于未来生物磁测量、零磁科学、国防安全、深空探测等领域的高精度磁场稳定系统的研制工作。

data.title: 北京大学洪浩特聘副研究员学术报告
data.topic: 叠层二维单晶的制备研究
data.speaker: 张志斌
data.listTitle: 北京大学洪浩特聘副研究员学术报告
data.abstract: 叠层二维材料不仅集成了单层的优越物性(如高载流子迁移率,高力学模量及超快光电响应),同时还展现出超越单层的性能。近年来,通过构造二维材料的纵向叠层结构,陆续发现了莫特绝缘态、反常超导态、摩尔激子态及奇异铁磁性等新奇物理现象,这为探索其中的新颖物性和开发先进的器件结构提供了广阔的研究平台。本报告将从叠层二维单晶的制备出发,探讨其可控单晶合成策略。
data.speakerBio: 张志斌，北京大学博雅博士后，本科毕业于西安交通大学（2017），博士毕业于北京大学物理学院（2020）。之后在北京大学物理学院从事博士后研究。主要从事单晶低维材料的可控制备与物性研究，深入开发了米级单晶铜箔库及高质量单晶石墨的可控制备技术并探索了其在材料催化等领域的直接应用。近年来，发表共同第一作者及通讯作者文章9篇，包括Nature、Nature Nanotechnology、Chem（2篇）、Advanced Materials Interfaces等。

data.title: 学术报告-符方伟
data.topic: Some New Constructions of MDS Euclidean Self-Dual Codes
data.speaker: 符方伟
data.speakerAffiliation: 南开大学陈省身数学研究所
data.listTitle: 学术报告-符方伟
data.abstract: In this talk, we consider the problem for which lengths an MDS Euclidean self-dual code over Fq exists. This problem is completely solved for the case where q is even. For q is odd, some q-ary MDS Euclidean self-dual codes were obtained in the literatures. We construct some new classes of q-ary MDS Euclidean self-dual codes by using generalized Reed-Solomon (GRS for short) codes and extended GRS codes. Finally, we talk some recent progress and future research problems on this topic. 学术
data.speakerBio: 符方伟,分别于1984年、1987年和1990年获得南开大学理学(数学)学士、硕士和博士学位。1987年7月至今在南开大学数学科学学院工作。现为南开大学陈省身数学研究所教授和博士生导师、中国工业与应用数学学会理事、中国工业与应用数学学会编码密码及相关组合理论专业委员会副主任委员、中国电子学会信息论分会副主任委员、中国密码学会理事、学术期刊《密码学报》和《电子与信息学报》的编委。入选2000年度教育部跨世纪优秀人才培养计划。2000年获国务院政府特殊津贴。主要从事编码理论及其应用、密码学及其应用、信息论及其应用的研究工作,在国际和国内重要学术期刊与国际会议论文集上发表论文300余篇。作为负责人承担了国家自然科学基金和教育部的多项科研项目,作为课题负责人承担了科技部973项目和国家重点研发计划项目。

data.title: 学术报告-岳勤
data.topic: MDS or NMDS self-dual codes from twisted generalized Reed-Solomon codes
data.speaker: 岳勤
data.speakerAffiliation: 南京航空航天大学数学系
data.listTitle: 学术报告-岳勤
data.abstract: Self-dual maximum distance separable codes (self-dual MDS codes) and self-dual near MDS (NMDS) codes are very important in coding theory and practice. Thus, it is interesting to construct self-dual MDS or self-dual NMDS codes. In this paper, we not only give parity-check matrices of dual codes of twisted generalized Reed-Solomon codes (TGRS codes) but also present a sufficient and necessary condition of self-dual TGRS codes over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with $q$ an odd prime. Moreover, we construct several classes of self-dual MDS or self-dual NMDS codes from TGRS codes. 学术

data.speaker: 黄煜
data.listTitle: 学术报告-黄煜
data.abstract: In this talk, several kinds of entropies which play important role in networked control systems are introduced. They are topological entropy, estimation entropy, feedback topological entropy and invariant entropy. Then we focus on invariant entropy, discussing some elementary properties of invariant entropy and giving the concept of the measure-theoretic invariant entropy. In particular, we establish several kinds of variational principles. 学术

data.title: 什么影响了我们的语言认知风格？
data.topic: 什么影响了我们的语言认知风格？
data.speaker: 刘思
data.speakerAffiliation: 华南师范大学心理学院
data.listTitle: 什么影响了我们的语言认知风格？
data.abstract: 语言认知不仅仅是对语言符号信息的加工，还涉及大量来自我们身体经验的感知运动信息的参与。当我们的语言认知偏好以不同的信息来加工时，就造成了语言认知风格的不同。相关语言认知的理论也经历了从关注语言符号信息，到关注感知运动信息，到关注二者共同作用的发展。在此背景下，本次讲座将和大家分享，探讨哪些因素影响我们语言认知中对这两种信息使用偏好的三个研究。

data.abstract: 神经元的选择性易感性是衰老和大多数神经退行性疾病共有的特征,这些易感神经元退变与死亡介导了相关脑区的生理功能退化及损伤,从而引起了衰老和神经退行性疾病中的行为学异常,但目前针对这一特征性病理改变的研究较少,易感神经元退变与死亡的机制也并不清楚。围绕这一关键科学问题,实验室从社会应激,表观遗传调控的角度对衰老与神经退行性疾病中的易感神经元退变与死亡的分子机制进行了深度解析,先后发现了miR-124等重要分子在介导易感神经元退变与死亡中的关键作用,并有针对性的开展了保护措施探讨。

data.title: 北京大学张笑鸣博士学术报告
data.topic: 多比特量子态制备的线路优化问题
data.speaker: 张笑鸣
data.listTitle: 北京大学张笑鸣博士学术报告
data.abstract: 量子态制备是量子信息,量子计算中的基础问题,它对应将经典信息编码到量子系统的过程。此外,量子态制备还是许多量子算法的必要步骤,它的效率决定了对应算法的运行复杂度。本报告将讨论对于多比特的一般量子态量子态及稀疏量子态,如何以最优线路深度、量子门个数实现目标态的制备。我们也将讨论相关算法基于表面码(surface code)的容错实现方案。 本报告还将介绍相关结论在哈密顿量模拟、量子线性方程组求解等问题上的应用。
data.speakerBio: 张笑鸣现为北京大学前沿计算研究中心博士后,受博雅博士后项目资助。本科毕业于华南师范大学物理学勷勤创新班,2021年获得香港城市大学博士学位。他主要从事量子计算、量子信息相关理论研究,研究兴趣包括量子线路优化、量子模拟算法设计、机器学习与量子计算的结合等。代表工作包括提出多项式线路深度的理想量子态制备方案;提出最优线路深度的稀疏量子态制备方案;以及深度强化学习在态传输等问题中的应用。在Physical Review Letter, npj Quantum information 以及 Physical Review 系列期刊以第一或通讯作者身份共发表9篇文章。

data.title: 华中师范大学谢丽副教授学术报告
data.topic: 机械波传播概念学习中知识整合的测评与教学干预研究
data.speaker: 谢丽
data.listTitle: 华中师范大学谢丽副教授学术报告
data.abstract: 加强学生对物理概念的深度理解是过去几十年物理教育研究一直关注的重点。本研究基于知识整合的视角,构建了波传播概念框架模型。基于此框架可以明确地建模学生的知识结构,并衡量他们的知识整合水平,揭示出学生在问题解决中的推理路径。同时,该框架能够帮助教师进行及时有效的诊断,为教学干预提供了新方法。教师可以在教学中明确地引入某一主题的核心概念,将其直接与解决问题的应用过程联系起来,通过发展学生知识结构中缺失的基本环节来改善他们知识整合的程度,促进他们对物理概念的深度理解。
data.speakerBio: 谢丽,华中师范大学物理科学与技术学院副教授,硕士研究生导师,美国俄亥俄州立大学访问学者。主要研究方向为中美国际比较教育、深度学习的教育模型、教育测量模型、科学探究、教育技术与新课程设计。主持教育部人文社科青年基金1项,湖北省高等学校教研项目2项,湖北省教育科学规划项目1项。获得2022年湖北省优秀基础教育教学成果二等奖。以第一作者/通讯作者发表论文三十余篇,其中SSCI检索1篇,CSSCI检索3篇,人大复印资料全文转载5篇。
